content.v: Out on PS5 from 3rd December 2026.
One of the classics that helped create an entire genre, stealth masterpiece Thief: The Dark Project is coming to PS5 in remastered form next month, from 3rd December 2026.

This new version of the 1998 game has been remastered using Nightdive Studios' KEX Engine to produce a new edition running at 4K and 120 frames-per-second. It's got all the content of the base game, the three extra missions from Thief: Gold, and an entirely new campaign in the form of The Tarnished Mirror.

items.title: 克劳德·代码刚刚制定了一条新规则：停止复制他人的游戏
items.summary: AI clones and vibe-coded copycat games have become a huge headache for developers recently, but it looks like

content.v: AI clones and vibe-coded copycat games have become a huge headache for developers recently, but it looks like an update to Anthropic's Claude Code's "rules" has been pushed out. Listed under "tengu_heron_brook," the tweak to the AI now directs it not to copy games and assets, and users cannot disable this setting.

Spotted by Chasm on X (via Game Developer ), the full rule reads, "Do build original games, games in a genre, and games from the user’s own designs and assets. Don't build a recreation of a specific existing game, even if it is renamed or called original". Anthropic's Addy Osmani added that "two sentences" were added to Claude Code's prompt on Opus 5.5, to steer it away from recreating someone else's specific game, as "using Claude to infringe IP " is against the company's policy. "Original games, genre games, and games built from your own designs and assets are meant to keep working. We'll continue to iterate to ensure we're striking the right balance."

AI clones have been running rampant for months now, as the tools have let pretty much anyone crank out copies of successful games in surprisingly little time compared to traditional methods of cloning a successful piece of work. This all came to a head during Steam Next Fest last month, when the demo showcase was flooded with low-effort games and AI slop. This has also led several developers to cancel demos outright, fearing bad actors could take the code, whip up a copy in Claude, and release it before their game ships.

Valve has vaguely mentioned that it's "aware of the situation" and that "a significant number of people are thinking about how to solve" the problem. At the same time, Valve has encouraged developers to focus on building communities and support for games, which isn't exactly an ideal solution. Creating a community around a game takes time, whereas AI slop clones can be generated fast enough to capitalize on virality, and in an ideal situation, make a quick buck for the prompter on the other end--just look at all the video games about needles in haystacks that have popped up recently, copying the viral success of Needle in a Haystack Simulator, which isn't out yet.

The rampant reverse-engineering got so bad that the creator behind Needle in a Haystack Simulator, NasNakarus, poked fun at it by teasing a joke mode for the game where players will have to sift through piles of cloned games to find the original.

While tweaking Claude is good news, it doesn't mean developers are out of the woods yet. Claude prompters will likely look for ways to work around the new restrictions, and if they're unsuccessful, other AI agents are available without the same safeguards.

items.title: 《毁灭战士》开发团队在一半工作室被解雇后表示“我们做得很好”
items.summary: Doom developer id Software was among the numerous Microsoft-owned game studios that cut staff recently as part

content.v: Doom developer id Software was among the numerous Microsoft-owned game studios that cut staff recently as part of the big Xbox "reset." What's the vibe like internally at the studio in the wake of that? Studio co-director Marty Stratton said in a recent interview, "We're doing great."

He said he wasn't trying to "handwave" the layoffs, and isn't shying away from acknowledging that "half of our studio" was laid off, IGN reported . Stratton said the layoffs were part of a "deliberate effort" to ensure id Software would succeed.

Stratton is an executive at id Software, and his perspective on the situation no doubt differs from other people at the studio. He didn't share any commentary on what the vibes are like internally at id currently for other people who survived the layoffs.
Stratton also mentioned how the shift brought id and MachineGames closer together--the two studios had always been "very close," but now the pair are working closer "than ever."

"We're at a point with technology development that both teams are incredibly talented and have incredibly talented engineers and we're really on an amazing path that had started pre-[layoffs]. We'd kicked this off earlier this year. We're really excited about that. We're both really really bullish on what we have ahead," he said.

The studio's latest release was 2025's Doom: The Dark Ages, while MachineGames released Indiana Jones and the Great Circle in 2024. It's rumored that MachineGames is now making a new Wolfenstein game .

items.title: 我们终于知道是谁制作了《塞尔达传说：时之笛》重制版
items.summary: Fans have speculated on which studio is leading the development of The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time remake

content.v: Fans have speculated on which studio is leading the development of The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time remake since it was first announced, and a new Ask the Developer feature from Nintendo appears to give us the answer.

The interviewees in Nintendo's online feature include longtime Zelda producer Eiji Aonuma and several members of Nintendo Entertainment Planning & Development (EPD) Production Group No. 3, which is the team behind the mainline Zelda games. In other words, the usual Zelda people are making the new Zelda game, as opposed to another studio like Monolith Soft or Grezzo.

Those other two studios have come up in fan discussions about the Ocarina of Time remake, due to their respective histories contributing to the Zelda franchise. Grezzo was behind the 3DS remakes of Ocarina of Time and Majora's Mask, along with the Switch remake of Link's Awakening. The studio also co-developed Echoes of Wisdom with EPD No. 3.

Monolith Soft, the Nintendo subsidiary behind the Xenoblade games, has taken more of a support role with Zelda games in recent years. The studio is credited with contributing to Skyward Sword, Breath of the Wild , and Tears of the Kingdom.

Fans had guessed that either or both studios were working on the Ocarina remake for Switch 2, theorizing that EPD No. 3 was working on a new, mainline Zelda game. Neither Monolift Soft nor Grezzo are mentioned in the first two parts of the Ask the Developer feature (parts 3 and 4 will be published on November 3), but it's still entirely possible that they could be involved in the production as support studios. We'll have to wait and check the credits when the game launches on November 5 .
For now, be comforted knowing that development on the Ocarina remake is being led by veterans of the beloved series, satisfying the fan desire to know exactly who's making these Nintendo games .

items.title: 玩家地位在英伟达沦为地板：营收占比十年降十倍
items.summary: 快科技11月2日消息，对PC游戏玩家来说，2026年是艰难的一年，2027年可能会更难，内存、SSD、CPU涨价不说，GPU显卡涨价也异常凶猛。

content.v: 快科技11月2日消息，对PC游戏玩家来说，2026年是艰难的一年，2027年可能会更难，内存、SSD、CPU涨价不说，GPU显卡涨价也异常凶猛。
比涨价更可怕的是玩家可能连显卡都买不到，这里面除了商家囤货居奇之外，还跟上游有关，最近传出了RTX 5090、RTX 5080显卡都要限供、停产的消息，原因跟AI需求有关。
也不需要多复杂的解释了，RTX 5090显卡哪怕涨价到五六万块钱，利润也不如将GB102核心用于AI显卡的利润多，在需求失衡的情况下NVIDIA肯定会选择保大。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/11/02/small_202611022319521854.png
这背后就涉及到NVIDIA公司今年来业务转型的情况了，网友whiskeyhacker汇总了2016年到2025年中NVIDIA的业务变化情况，10年前NVIDIA的营收也就70亿美元，游戏业务贡献了59%的收入，可以说是绝对的主力，NVIDIA自然会把重点放在游戏玩家身上。
这个趋势一直持续到2021年，游戏卡业务都能贡献一半的收入，2022年减少到了34%，但也是核心业务之一，真正的转折点是2023年，游戏业务占比直接减少到17%，再往后就一路降低，2025年就只有7%了。
今年的财报还没出，估计游戏业务连5%的份额都没了，因为今年的业绩依然是AI显卡暴涨，也难怪NVIDIA已经把游戏卡业务划归到其他部分了。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/11/02/small_202611022320154590.png
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/11/02/small_202611022320154606.png
如果看绝对的营收额，游戏业务每年还是能贡献不少收入的，但是大家也得承认重心已经不可逆转的变了，保90%的业务还是5%的业务，任何公司都会做出倾向前者的业务。
游戏玩家现在只能面对现实了，已经不是NVIDIA的VIP了，自然没法要求更多，现在的情况下主流显卡都不一定买得起，几万块的RTX 5090就算真的不卖了，影响也就那样。

items.summary: Out with the old, in with the Aonuma. "Hang on, why is Nintendo remaking Ocarina of Time again?" It's a natura

content.v: Out with the old, in with the Aonuma.

"Hang on, why is Nintendo remaking Ocarina of Time again?" It's a natural question that might have occurred to you in the last few months, and in the latest Ask the Developer interview, Series Producer Eiji Aonuma had the answer.

Part of the reason for returning to the title, it turns out, was to try to "trigger new insights" from the developers that may feed into future Zelda games. "Many of the team members who work alongside me on Legend of Zelda games today have only experienced developing the more recent titles," Aonuma-san says. "That led me to wonder, 'Do they truly understand just how significant The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time was to the series as a whole?'"

items.title: 外媒称R星越来越像陶德：《GTA6》宣传话术都一样
items.summary: 据外媒Shazoo报道，Rockstar对《GTA6》的宣传话术，正越来越接近Bethesda的陶德·霍华德式营销

content.v: https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/11/02/small_202611022303579836.png
据外媒Shazoo报道，Rockstar对《GTA6》的宣传话术，正越来越接近Bethesda的陶德·霍华德式营销：核心逻辑是“你可以去任何地方，并在那里发现点什么”。文章将这种风格与陶德当年宣传《上古卷轴5：天际》时的经典说法相提并论——“那座山不是背景，你可以爬到山顶”。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/11/02/small_202611022304453886.png
到了《星空》，陶德的类似话术更加直白。他在接受IGN采访时说：“我们宁愿把它们做出来，然后对你说‘嘿，你可以降落在上面’。”他还描绘了这样一幅画面：“你想去降落在那个奇怪的星球上，看看它，建一个前哨站，在那里过你的日子，因为喜欢看卫星的景色就看看日落？去吧。”社区甚至衍生出一句广为流传的调侃：“看到那颗星球了吗？你可以降落在上面。”
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/11/02/small_202611022304527028.png
具体到《GTA6》，Rockstar North联合负责人Aaron Garbut在采访中表示，游戏地图面积几乎赶上《GTA4》《5》和《荒野大镖客：救赎2》三张地图的总和，但团队没有依赖程序化生成，而是坚持手工打磨，室内空间数量比以往作品“多一个数量级”。Garbut称，每个角落都经过同样细致的处理，随便走进一个随机地点，背后都有一群人认真做过。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/11/02/small_202611022304587443.png
不过，这种宣传方式并非没有风险。GameRant曾在一篇分析中指出，星空在发售前进行了长时间的详细演示，开发者对大量细节的承诺让玩家产生了过高的期待，最终部分内容未能完全兑现，对口碑造成了影响。该文当时就建议Rockstar从星空的发布中吸取教训，不要在发售前做出过多承诺。

items.title: V 出现在 Edgerunners 2 中吗？ 《赛博朋克 2077》有佳能结局吗？那么第三季呢？我们在新的采访中询问了节目制作人
items.summary: Edgerunners 2 showrunner Bartosz Sztybor on all things Cyberpunk, including V's apparent appearance, canon end

content.v: https://assets-prd.ignimgs.com/2026/10/19/cyberpunk-edgerunners-talia-thumb-1792444102039.jpg

Edgerunners, the hugely popular Netflix anime set in CD Projekt’s Cyberpunk 2077 world, takes what’s great about the video game and expertly translates it into the world of animation. The recently released Season 2 told its own story — one we know is set just a year after the events of the main game , in 2078 (more on this later) — and it all wraps up nicely. But wait! Was that a tease for V in the show? And, if that’s true, does that mean there’s an ending of Cyberpunk 2077 that CD Projekt considers canon, and thus acts as the jumping off point for all post-game spinoffs like Edgerunners 2?

At the Lucca Comics and Games festival, we got the chance to put all this to Edgerunners writer, producer, and showrunner Bartosz Sztybor, who did his best to answer without giving much of the game away. And speaking of giving the game away, what about that Season 3?

The world of Cyberpunk is set to expand further, of course, with the in-development Cyberpunk 2 (where and when the game takes place is yet to be announced). There's also a live-action film in the works, although according to CD Projekt, the Cyberpunk 2077 movie won't retrace the game's steps .

IGN: Eagle-eyed fans spotted that in the scene in the data archive, there's a wall of images and there's one that looks like it may be female V. Was that intentional, or something left to interpretation?
Bartosz Sztybor: It's left for interpretation. But also the dialogue that they're having there is, I think, very important. So yeah, it's left for interpretation.
Yeah I ain’t crazy that’s deadass V https://t.co/3XC5KtlrDa
IGN: Easter eggs from the game, is that an important thing for you all to include?

Bartosz Sztybor: It's not important at all. That's why I wouldn't call it Easter eggs. I think that's the way we are trying to create a franchise for Cyberpunk. So, to create standalone stories that are self-sufficient, that you can just read one comic book and you are having the catharsis and you don't need to know any other comic book or a game or other stuff. But we are putting those things that are not as a fan service, but for the audience or the readers to feel that this world is alive. That's why we don't want to create anime or animation or a comic book that will need the audience to read three other comic books and two TV shows to understand why this guy is a villain. But I like to put those many things like Sal Bigelow in Edgerunners 2, who was what, five years earlier in the comic book Cyberpunk: Big City Dreams. But only if there’s a reason.
So it's never thinking that, oh, what we should put in this scene to make fans happy? It's about building a bigger narrative.

IGN: When you are setting something after the game, after 2077, do you have conversations with CDPR about a canon ending for the game, that would set up a world state for Edgerunners 2? Or is it more kind of abstract than that?

Bartosz Sztybor: It's both, I would say. It's not like super abstract, but also, we don't want to set a canon ending. So there were a lot of conversations again with the lore team to see what we can do to somehow satisfy all the endings, and what will be the state of the world after the game. That's why the scene that you asked about, we don't want to be straightforward, but we are giving some suggestions that will probably reveal the state of the world in more comic books and other stuff. So there are discussions. There are discussions, but we are not setting one kind of ending.
IGN: When you're writing these stories, do you have a set canon in mind, or is it a little bit more variable than that?

Bartosz Sztybor: There is canon, of course. But again, when we were creating Edgerunners 1 and multiple comic books and board games, the canon was before the game. So we knew the state of the world. And for the things post-game, it's not that there are super detailed canon things, but one important canon information is that Arasaka is weakened and that's it. And it gives us a lot of opportunities to show the city in a different way.
But again, it's not detailed. So it doesn't make any of the endings canon. But the things that happened in the game could lead to that, whatever your choice was.
IGN: Is that something in your mind that you're trying to stay away from things that would be too specific in terms of setting up new canon?

Bartosz Sztybor: Yeah. It's the same thing that I answered about the characters. There are some IP that are created in a way — I won't mention the name — that are created in a way... And I think that the goal of CDPR, the way we want to create franchises for The Witcher and Cyberpunk is to, again, create standalone stories. So you have a graphic novel and you can read it from the start to finish. You don't need to know anything about the world, but you can have the Easter eggs or some connections that build the world, that show you that, okay, this world exists. And I prefer to create a franchise like that.

I like fans who find those things. There’s a comic book called You Have My Word, and there was a fixer [Arthur Cormac] that you saw in Edgerunners 1. And I think only 20 or 30 fans found that. And then that fixer also had a cameo in another comic book. And those three things happen at different times.

So as a fan, you can create their story, you can connect the dots. And I think this is the best way to create a franchise, because you let the fans stay with the story, think about the story, and you don't give them answers. You just give them questions and they can connect things.
So I don't know if I answered the question, but I think that's the way we want to create the franchise.
IGN: What are your thoughts right now on a potential Edgerunners 3? Is it something that you are open to and maybe just waiting for a story? What are your feelings on that right now?

Bartosz Sztybor: When writing Season 1, I was already thinking about other seasons, about other stories because there's a lot of stories to tell. Always when I'm creating, I'm searching for answers to questions that I don't know how to answer. So I knew that after Season 1, I didn't answer all the questions. So there was a dream of creating more seasons.

But I think it's always with CDPR, only if there's a perfect story and perfect people to deliver, then we can do it. And after Season 1, Studio Trigger said, "No, we are just too tired." But then here in Lucca, right after the release of Season 1, we talked with Studio Trigger and they said, "Okay, we are not that tired anymore, so maybe we should do it." And I already had ideas. So two months later I presented a pitch to them, because also they said we don't want to do a sequel, like a classic sequel.

And we have CDPR and we as well, we didn't want to do that as well. We wanted to do something different. So when I presented them a pitch for Season 2, they were super impressed and that's why Season 3 happened. I think that's the same story with Season 3. So I have some stories, but we need to see. If there's no studio or director with a vision like Ikarashi, it doesn't make sense. We don't want to do things that will be mediocre or not good enough. So the ideas are there, but I’m also with how Season 2 completes Season 1. So I think as a package, it already works.

items.title: 青沼英二：时之笛RE是让新员工练手 好做塞尔达新作
items.summary: 塞尔达系列制作人青沼英二表示，重制《时之笛》的原因之一，是帮助新加入的开发者理解这部作品对整个系列的意义

content.v: 据任天堂官方访谈，塞尔达系列制作人青沼英二表示，重制《时之笛》的原因之一，是帮助新加入的开发者理解这部作品对整个系列的意义。他指出，今年是《塞尔达传说》初代发售40周年，作为系列制作人，他一直在思考应该做些什么。如今团队中许多成员只参与过较新作品的开发，这让他产生疑问：他们是否真正明白《时之笛》对系列有多重要。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/11/02/small_202611022256082577.png
青沼英二提到，团队里有些人对《时之笛》只有模糊印象，有些人童年时玩过，但他更关心的是，这些开发者在未来制作塞尔达新作时，会如何理解和消化这部经典。他认为，通过学习原版的游戏结构和开发方式，并亲手将其完全重制，团队成员可能获得新的启发，并把这些经验带到后续开发中。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/11/02/small_202611022256169292.png
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/11/02/small_202611022256173468.png
正是基于这一判断，团队认为现在重新审视《时之笛》是合适的时机。本作将于11月5日独占登陆Switch 2平台，由HokWai Ng担任总监，是他在任天堂首次以总监身份主导游戏开发。

items.title: 战争机器：E-Day 看似 5 亿美元的预算可能无法讲述全部故事 - 报告
items.summary: How much does a true console exclusive cost to make today? If recent reports are to be believed, Gears of War:

content.v: How much does a true console exclusive cost to make today? If recent reports are to be believed, Gears of War: E-Day had a production cost $500 million, but there's more to that figure than just a single game.

That's according to Windows Central writer Jez Corden , who says he spoke with multiple sources familiar with the story behind the half-billion dollars paid over several years to The Coalition while it was working on Gears of War: E-Day . The studio emerged from the COVID-19 pandemic as a Swiss Army Knife developer that assisted not only on several Xbox games, but also worked on the technology powering them.

As Corden explained, The Coalition worked with Epic Games on the oThe Matrix Awakens and Alpha Point tech demos for Unreal Engine 5 demonstrations, and used that knowledge to help other developers in the Xbox Games Studio portfolio. The Coalition reportedly worked for over 18 months on a prototype game that was eventually canceled, assisted on Avowed, Hellblade 2, Clockwork Revolution, State of Decay 3, Grounded, and Grounded 2, and even contributed to the upcoming StarCraft at Blizzard.

Once Mike Crump was appointed studio head, development on Gears of War: E-Day reportedly kicked into full gear. That makes for a busy developer, and one that brings a lot of institutional knowledge to Xbox with its work on Unreal Engine 5, which is one of the most popular engines for video game development. "I can't help but feel like the '$500 million' figure being shared around internally is being used to justify potential cuts, layoffs, or worse, a studio closure targeting The Coalition. Perhaps to 'soften the blowback,' should Microsoft target the studio. For what it's worth, I've not heard that Xbox is planning to close The Coalition," Corden added.

Gears of War: E-Day has reportedly not sold well either , but this can be attributed to various factors. It was only released for PC and Xbox Series X|S, is also available through Xbox Game Pass, and it happened to launch during an exceptionally busy time, as the last couple of months have been loaded with several major game releases, creating a lot of competition for a person's attention and money.
Circana analyst Mat Piscatella recently commented on the game, saying that making Gears of War: E-Day exclusive to Xbox "hasn’t made any difference" in terms of selling more Xbox consoles.

items.title: 革命的火焰，遇春的冬雪：《明日方舟》「时间啊，向前！」文化向解读
items.summary: 乌萨斯，母亲...... 我在昏黑的夜里呼唤您的名字。 在日出之前，我就将死去。 而您，而您——我可爱的祖国， 您将在我的骨血之上重生， 如人们所希望的那般永恒。 乌萨斯，一片饱含着冲突与苦难的土地，也是《明日方舟》故事

content.v: 乌萨斯，母亲...... 我在昏黑的夜里呼唤您的名字。 在日出之前，我就将死去。 而您，而您——我可爱的祖国， 您将在我的骨血之上重生， 如人们所希望的那般永恒。
乌萨斯，一片饱含着冲突与苦难的土地，也是《明日方舟》故事的起点。玩家们的视角跟随着罗德岛，再一次回到了这里。
https://image.gcores.com/5bdc430379c075698ea3e069a8a40439-1920-820.png
那么我们也想趁新活动刚开，借题发散一下，来聊一聊文化和艺术相关的联想。
在这里提前说一句：以下的内容完全是我个人的理解与解读，相对零散，只为增加大家游玩新活动时的风味，无需纠结设定，图一乐即可。
时代的旋律
首先，让我们来看看这次活动的标题——「时间啊，向前！」。
它不是中文原创的句子，而是俄语 «Время, вперёд!» 的直译。
巧合的是， «Время, вперёд!»也是一段属于特定时代的旋律。1932 年，苏联作家卡达耶夫写了一本小说，名字就叫《时间，前进！》。这本小说讲的是那个年代最典型的苏联故事：围绕着马格尼托哥尔斯克钢铁厂的建设，在这样一个平凡的工地上，这样平凡的一天，一群新时代的工人们拼了命地想把混凝土的纪录再往前推一点点。
https://image.gcores.com/6ccc09d4093861fd1f5d60eea04182a1-298-478.png
1965 年，这本小说打动了导演施韦泽，他决定把这个故事改编成厚重的大银幕作品。斯维里多夫为这部电影写了配乐；1967 年，配乐又被整理成管弦组曲；到了 1968 年，这套组曲中最重要的一段旋律，成了苏联中央电视台晚间新闻节目《时间》的片头曲。
对于那个时代的人们来说，它不只是一首曲子，也不只是一篇小说，它是一个时代的记忆。它象征着那个尘封的、由贵族阶级把控着的沙皇俄国，迎来了一个属于人民的新时代——当前奏一响，人们就自觉地凑到收音机前，聆听今天国家发生了怎样的大事。
随着苏联解体，这段旋律也一度被冷落。直到 2014 年俄罗斯索契冬奥会的开幕式现场，这段勾起无数人回忆的音乐，才又一次被奏响。
有趣的是，对于今天的人们来说，这段旋律代表的是一个属于过去的时代；但对《明日方舟》本次活动的中心——乌萨斯而言，「时间啊，向前！」代表的，又好像是一个属于未来的时代。
https://image.gcores.com/50de415a437fd8da0bebd751fdf871fc-1920-874.png
我依然记得，曾经的乌萨斯展现出来的是怎样一种混乱与苦难。而当这次鹰角用这样一个标题，来开启这片土地上故事的新篇章时，也不禁让我心生遐想：滚滚向前的时间，最终会将这里的人们，推向一个怎样的未来？
https://image.gcores.com/4f4e7163a6bb9982182091495ea7b424-1920-1536.png
权力的阴影
然而，在新的春天到来之前，人们也必将面对旧日的反扑。
https://image.gcores.com/fdedd35df60364f7dd69f4eb45f6d028-1920-819.png
简单介绍一下俄国史上的特辖制（опричнина）。1565 年，沙皇伊凡四世把全国的土地切成两半：一半归沙皇直辖，叫"特辖区"；特辖区里组建了一支只忠于他本人的军队，穿黑衣、骑黑马，鞍前挂着一颗狗头和一把扫帚——狗头嗅叛徒，扫帚除余孽。
https://image.gcores.com/3adce708c6d601d744dc1cce37d8644e-760-400.png
从绘画采用的视觉元素和人物着装风格，可以看出特辖军是一群不受常规司法约束、靠恐惧维持秩序的人。
而搞出这套东西的，正是俄国历史上的第一位沙皇——伊凡雷帝。他是一个被权力腐蚀的人。
在实行特辖制的七年里，大量财产被抄没，大批人被流放，异己被成批处死。1570 年，他亲征诺夫哥罗德，在那里进行了长达数周的有组织屠杀。后世给了他一个名字：恐怖的伊凡。
https://image.gcores.com/96895d848844238356b2aa2b40946c46-330-618.png

他一生中最恐怖的一幕，被三百年后的俄国画家列宾画了下来。 1581 年 11 月 19 日，伊凡用一根铁头手杖，亲手打死了自己的长子伊凡。据传他因为怀孕的儿媳叶莲娜衣着不合礼制而动手打了她，皇子出面阻拦，父子争执起来。几个小时之内，叶莲娜流产；几天之后，皇子死去。 1885 年，列宾把这个场景画成了《伊凡雷帝杀子》。画里没有挥杖的那一下，他画的是之后：这位恐怖的沙皇瘫坐在地毯上，把奄奄一息的儿子搂在怀里，一只手按住儿子额头涌血的伤口，脸上涌现出的不再是凶狠，而是惊恐和后悔。
https://image.gcores.com/039572b9a144e80d46e5890b302b9531-2495-1916.png
这幅画之所以直抵人心，很大程度上是因为：造成皇子死亡的，恰恰是一根象征着权力的杖。
微妙的是，伊凡打死长子之后，真正坐上皇位的，是他的另一个儿子——叫费奥多尔。这位费奥多尔虔诚、软弱，史书多认为他不适合统治，实权落到了权臣戈杜诺夫手里；他死后，俄国进入"混乱时代"。
这根权杖在1774年，为叶卡捷琳娜二世镶制而成。顶端的奥尔洛夫钻石重达 189.62 克拉，象征着持有权杖之人，至高无上的统治。伊凡到死也没能放下那根权杖，为此他甚至亲手杀死了自己的继承人。
乌萨斯的故事却呈现出了截然不同的走向，这点即使是从「时间啊，向前！」的先导 PV 里也可见一斑：象征皇权的权杖，一次又一次地出现，但却最终和王座一起，焚毁于火光之中。
https://image.gcores.com/8c3fbe8d484cbc108b08750f2a243eab-1919-885.png
https://image.gcores.com/a78d2656eabc4bcb75093cb1ca5016bb-1920-884.png
https://image.gcores.com/dcaf77304e63864dadedbda5d6099b55-1700-775.png
绘画的革命
接下来，我还是想多聊聊绘画。
在这次活动的游戏场景里，我们能看到各种各样的绘画元素。很多画面都有古典油画般的质感——这似乎是一种和整合运动、和罗德岛都截然不同的气质。但我们又将看到，这一切华美的腐朽，最终都被裹进一团熊熊的烈火。
https://image.gcores.com/a4d0cf2f910224a23178268662d6ab3a-1600-900.png
说回《伊凡雷帝杀子》这张画。列宾在 1881 年为什么要画它？
因为在这一年的 3 月 1 日，亚历山大二世在圣彼得堡被炸死。新任沙皇继位之后，做的第一件事就是在全国实行残酷的镇压：五名刺客被绞死，全国上下收紧审查，搜捕和流放接连不断。而列宾在那几年里，一直在为这些革命者画像——被捕的宣传员、拒绝忏悔的囚犯、突然回家的流放者。他自己说，那几年里相继发生了许多流血的事件，"仿佛有一种力量在催促着我"。
就是在这样的情境下，他画下了《伊凡雷帝杀子》这样一幅历史画。与皇宫中所有的画像不同，画面里的人象征的不再是至高无上的皇权，而是一个可恨又可怜的、杀死了自己儿子的父亲。所以在某种程度上说，这张画就是一张煽动性的标语，用一种特殊的语言告诉当时的人们——王权没有永恒。
而在当时的俄国画界，列宾并不是唯一一个这样做的人。

1870 年，一批青年俄国画家正式成立了一个名为"巡回展览画派"的协会。1871 年，他们的首个展览在圣彼得堡开幕。自此之后，他们开启了一场又一场的巡回展览，从彼得堡、莫斯科，一路到基辅、哈尔科夫、敖德萨。 后来，这批人几乎重新定义了"俄国绘画"这四个字。他们靠的是一个简单的理念：为普通人创作绘画，把普通人放进画布。 从纤夫、囚犯、分裂教徒到乞丐，这些在过去从来和绘画不沾边的普通民众，成为了画面中的主角。 而如果我们将镜头转回乌萨斯。 不难发现，我们最开始认识的整合运动，恰恰就是一股被长期忽视的愤怒的力量。他们是矿工，是感染者，是从被清剿的村庄里苟活下来的人。曾经我们看到的他们，是一股燎原的野火，带着愤怒，期望烧掉一切旧有的东西。实际上，面具之下的他们，也只是无奈拿起刀剑的普通民众。
而现在，这团昔日的野火中，也将诞生一些新的东西——由乌萨斯人组成的，拥抱理想和信念的新意志，将烧出一个崭新的未来。
尾声
最后，我们再念叨一下「时间」。
「时间啊，向前！」三段关卡名连起来是一条线：残照终尽、长冬初青、世纪之春。在活动页上我们能找到这样一段文字：
在春天到来前，我将自己埋入土里。 听醋栗萌芽，花楸的果实坠地。 ...... 它说：时间啊，我听见你。 已逝去的存在，不会被忘记。
曾经塔露拉在切尔诺伯格的废墟里第一次出场；如今她回到乌萨斯，回到这片将她塑造的冻土。一段七年多前埋下的故事，也将在这个版本里迎来收尾。
时间啊，向前，冬去春来，泰拉的时间还在走，还有太多的故事要发生。但乌萨斯这一站的意义，也许恰恰就在于迎来未来的希望。
当革命的火焰融化尘封的冬雪，我相信留给这片大地的，是一颗新的果实落地的声音。

items.title: 《红沙》新增结婚系统需先调情 玩够了可以离婚
items.summary: 据IGN报道，《红色沙漠》在“未知旅途”DLC中加入恋爱与结婚系统，每个可玩角色都能与游戏世界中的几乎所有NPC结婚。

content.v: 据IGN报道，《红色沙漠》在“未知旅途”DLC中加入恋爱与结婚系统，每个可玩角色都能与游戏世界中的几乎所有NPC结婚。
具体操作上，玩家需要先锁定NPC，从新的交互菜单里选择交互，随后会出现调情、赠送礼物和聊天三个选项。反复调情可把恋爱计量表推到100，达到上限后才能求婚；未满100就求婚会被拒绝，并损失大量信任点。
https://img1b.gamersky.com/new/content/2026/11/02/cas_auto/small_0_9229186.jpg
调情每天有次数限制。攻略页称，每个游戏内日只能通过这些方式提升一次NPC的恋爱等级，聊过去的冒险或送礼可以加快进度。
这套恋爱系统与本体已有的NPC信任机制完全独立。即便某位NPC的信任已经满100，恋爱值仍要从零开始。可攻略的NPC在交互时右上角会显示带爱心的计量表；不可攻略的对象，交互提示旁会出现带爱心的人形划掉图标。
https://img1b.gamersky.com/new/content/2026/11/02/cas_auto/small_0_9229187.jpg
攻略举例称，主角似乎无法攻略大多数灰鬃成员，而女巫等部分NPC需要先完成特定任务。
攻略还提到一项跨角色影响：用某个角色与NPC调情，会降低该NPC与其他可玩角色之间的信任等级。
https://img1b.gamersky.com/new/content/2026/11/02/cas_auto/small_0_9229192.jpg
结婚后，配偶会像其他可玩角色一样永久标注在地图上，可以召唤并一起旅行，也会定期送上小礼物。玩家不带着配偶冒险时，对方会待在本体的灰鬃营地住所，或DLC中新建的住所。配偶外观可在理发店调整，但幅度有限，若不想继续这段婚姻，也可以在改版后的交互菜单中离婚。

items.title: 《影之刃零》千万记得手动存档!错过支线真结局就没了
items.summary: 国产动作游戏《影之刃零》发售已有一段时间，在此提醒大家在探索过程中尽量做一些保险工作，以及留意一些容易错过的内容，以免遗漏…

content.v: 注：本文主要内容包含对《影之刃零》的些许剧透（不多，几乎没啥）。
《影之刃零》 热销中 ！叠加金币至高省32元。
国产动作游戏《影之刃零》发售已有一段时间，在此提醒大家在探索过程中尽量做一些保险工作，以及留意一些容易错过的内容，以免遗漏支线任务、特殊道具、成就甚至错过真结局。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/11/02/small_202611021232547069.png
1. 区域最终Boss战前务必手动存档
在挑战每个区域的最终Boss前，最好在铃铛处保留一份手动存档。如果直接推进到下一个区域，部分任务可能会因此无法继续完成，导致错过相关道具和成就奖杯。
尤其是在打第二章关底Boss“白赤练”前和进入游戏后期的“ 戏梦山庄 ”地图前。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/11/02/small_202611021233103636.png
2. 大胆尝试不同武器
不必担心升级武器技能后无法反悔，游戏允许玩家重置武器强化。因此，玩家可以根据自己的喜好尝试不同武器和技能组合，不必拘泥于某一种固定搭配。
武器10级以前可以免费退回升级资源，10级-20级重置武器强化需消耗1个逆炼符，20级-30级需消耗2个逆炼符，主武器与影之武装均如是。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/11/02/small_202611021233303918.png
3. 不要忽视饰品与影之武装
饰品和影之武装对战斗的影响相当大。部分饰品能够提高对特定敌人类型的伤害，也能提供其他战斗增益；一些影之武装则可以打断敌人的攻击，甚至破坏敌方护盾，让原本棘手的战斗变得更加轻松。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/11/02/small_202611021233417764.png
上述内容都是游玩过程中值得留意的细节，尤其是区域推进前的存档，可能直接影响玩家能否收集齐全。对于还在探索《影之刃零》的玩家来说，不妨提前留意。

items.title: "如龙之父"名越稔洋工作室官宣解散！再无马东锡龙帮
items.summary: 公告要求债权人在刊登次日起两个月内申报，否则将从清算中除斥。

others.title: 名越稔洋工作室现已正式解散

content.v: 据日媒Game*Spark报道，由《如龙》系列知名制作人名越稔洋率领的名越工作室，已根据2026年10月31日召开的股东大会决议正式解散。相关消息于11月2日刊登在日本官报上。
https://img1b.gamersky.com/new/content/2026/11/02/cas_auto/small_0_9231660.jpg
根据11月2日刊登于日本官报（号外第240号）的解散公告，名越工作室已于10月31日根据股东大会决议解散。公告中还列出了代表清算人森永实的名字。
https://img1b.gamersky.com/new/content/2026/11/02/cas_auto/small_0_9231675.jpg
公告要求持有该公司债权的债权人，自公告刊登次日起两个月内向公司申报债权。如果未能在规定期限内申报，其债权将被排除在清算程序之外。
日本株式会社解散后，将进入清算程序，对公司的债权债务等进行整理。待清算工作完成并办理清算结了登记后，公司的法人资格才会正式消灭。本次公告正是清算程序的一部分，旨在通知债权人申报相关债权。
https://img1b.gamersky.com/new/content/2026/11/02/cas_auto/small_0_9231690.jpg
Game*Spark曾于10月5日报道称，根据对名越工作室公司登记簿的调查，该公司当时仍处于存续状态。另一方面，包括名越稔洋在内的所有董事均已于2026年3月31日卸任。随后，森永实于5月31日重新出任董事，并兼任代表董事，公司同时废除了设置董事会和监事的相关规定。截至10月5日，名越工作室仅剩森永实一名在任董事。
据了解，名越工作室于2022年1月正式开设官方网站，是一家由网易游戏100%出资成立的游戏开发公司。当时，工作室表示将以主机平台为中心，开发面向全球市场的高品质游戏。
https://img1b.gamersky.com/new/content/2026/11/02/cas_auto/small_0_9231706.jpg
2025年12月举行的TGA颁奖典礼上，工作室公布了由马东锡主演的全新动作冒险游戏《GANG OF DRAGON》。
然而，2026年3月，彭博社报道称网易将停止向名越工作室提供资金支持。4月，工作室的官方YouTube频道被删除（随后恢复）；5月，工作室官方网站也无法正常访问。
https://img1b.gamersky.com/new/content/2026/11/02/cas_auto/small_0_9231728.jpg
截至本文撰写时，《GANG OF DRAGON》在Steam上的商店页面仍然可以正常访问，发售日期依旧标注为“即将推出”。不过，遗憾的是，这款游戏很可能最终无法与玩家见面。
https://img1b.gamersky.com/new/content/2026/11/02/cas_auto/small_0_9231735.jpg

items.title: 《影之刃零》72小时卖400万！千万销量国单还远吗？
items.summary: 《影之刃零》72小时卖400万！千万销量国单还远吗？

content.v: 今日，《影之刃零》官方发布公告，宣布游戏发售72小时销量已经突破400万份，并感谢玩家这几天以来的支持与厚爱。官方同时表示，团队已经记录玩家反馈的各种问题，正在着手优化调整，近期将优先修复一批明显BUG。随着首发成绩正式公布，这款国产动作游戏也迎来了一个新的话题：从400万到1000万，还需要多久？
《影之刃零》 热销中 ！叠加金币至高省32元。

编辑观点： 说实话，72小时400万份已经是相当漂亮的开局，但我觉得《影之刃零》真正值得期待的，不只是首发能卖多少，而是它能不能把这波热度转化为长期口碑。千万销量当然是一个值得期待的目标，不过接下来还有很长的路要走。游戏后续的BUG修复、优化表现，以及玩家之间的口碑传播，都会影响它的长线表现。相比急着给它定下一个销量纪录，我更希望灵游坊能够把游戏持续打磨好，让更多原本不了解武侠动作游戏的玩家也愿意入坑。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/11/02/small_202611021040359150.jpg
从目前的情况来看，《影之刃零》并不缺少继续增长的基础。华丽的武侠动作、美术场景和BOSS战吸引了大量玩家，海外社区也出现了不少自发分享的体验评价。对于还没有购买的玩家来说，朋友推荐、直播内容以及后续口碑传播，都可能成为入坑的理由。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/11/02/small_202611021042384707.jpg
当然，想要突破千万销量也并非没有挑战。游戏发售初期往往是购买热情最集中的阶段，之后能否维持热度，还要看玩家评价、后续优化以及不同平台的持续销售表现。官方这次承诺修复明显BUG，也是影响玩家长期口碑的重要一环。如果开发团队能够持续改善体验，让更多观望玩家放心入手，销量就有机会进一步增长。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/11/02/small_202611021042497015.jpg
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/11/02/small_202611021042512135.jpg
那么，你认为《影之刃零》最终能突破1000万份吗？400万只是首发成绩，还是它已经接近自己的销量天花板？你觉得它还需要哪些改进，才能吸引更多玩家加入这场武侠冒险？

items.title: RTX 2/3/40显卡一键提升75%性能!不刷BIOS不改驱动
items.summary: RTX 20/30/40显卡一键提升75%性能！不刷BIOS、不改驱动

content.v: 开发者physicsdolphin在GitHub上发布了开源工具NV UEFI Unlocker，可解锁NVIDIA RTX 20、30、40系列显卡此前受限的Tensor Core计算性能，最高带来75%的AI算力提升。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/11/01/small_202611012041374475.png
该工具在NVIDIA显卡驱动加载前通过UEFI方式修改GPU行为，不需要永久刷写VBIOS或补丁驱动，不过解锁是临时的，断电后会自动恢复原状。
此前类似解锁方案主要依赖Linux内核模块，Zagitta开发的GPU Unlock项目曾让RTX 30系列在特定FP16/BF16计算负载下Tensor Core吞吐量接近翻倍，AI图像生成基准提升近60%，但一直局限于Linux平台。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/11/01/small_202611012041462029.png
NV UEFI Unlocker同时支持Windows、Linux及其他UEFI可启动系统，覆盖三代NVIDIA显卡，RTX 20、30、40系列都在支持列表中，GTX 16系列理论性支持，RTX 50系列不支持。
实测中，RTX 2070在FP32累积矩阵乘法中从36 TFLOPS提升到约60至63 TFLOPS，涨幅67%到75%。RTX 4060笔记本GPU的FP16计算吞吐量从29.89 TFLOPS涨到49.33 TFLOPS，提升65%。
安装需要制作一个包含UEFI应用和固件组件的启动U盘，从U盘启动后工具自动执行修改再把控制权交还操作系统，同时还需关闭安全启动或配置为信任该EFI应用，RTX 20系列用户还需先启用GSP固件模式。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/11/01/small_202611012041567504.jpg
项目仍处实验阶段，并非所有显卡或系统配置都能成功解锁，理论算力提升也不等于实际应用同等增幅，而且目前没有证据表明该修改能提升游戏性能。

items.title: 《生化危机》导演回应强烈反对：“我应该知道得更多”
items.summary: Resident Evil is a huge success at the box office, recently surpassing $400 million globally . It's also recei

content.v: Resident Evil is a huge success at the box office, recently surpassing $400 million globally . It's also received fantastic review scores. But hardcore fans of the game series took issue with the film and its direction because it did not contain any storylines or characters from the source material. Director Zach Cregger never intended to, instead opting for his own original story that is set in the world of Resident Evil. Now, Cregger has spoken more about the fallout, saying he became "frustrated at the conversation" around his movie and specifically how it "didn't have anything to do with the movie."

He said on The Town that the conversation from the hardcore Resident Evil fanbase was that the movie didn't live up to their standards, even though Cregger never said he was trying to make a movie that did that.
https://www.gamespot.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/11/removienew-1.png

He said he really loves and is proud of the movie he made. At the same time, Cregger admitted, "I should have known better" about how fans of the game series might react. Anyone who has been on the internet and engaged with anything related to gaming knows how intense hardcore gaming fans can be about even the seemingly smallest of issues, but Cregger said he overlooked this for reasons he doesn't fully understand.

"I should have understood that that was going to be the case," Cregger said about the blowback. Cregger previously said he was naive to think gamers would embrace him and his idea for the Resident Evil movie.

Cregger previously said he would never make another franchise movie after Resident Evil, but he's softened somewhat, saying on the podcast that he has a "never say never" attitude about it. Asked if Cregger's anti-franchise stance might limit his job opportunities in the future, Cregger said that after Barbarian and Weapons, he feels like he is "playing with house money."

Cregger said he's basically already won in life and the rest of his career is gravy. He said he goes into his projects now thinking it could be the last film he ever makes, and he's OK with that. "I'm going to swing for the f**king fences," he said. "I'm going to pour it all out to make this as good as I am capable of making it. And whatever happens, whether it makes a lot of money or no money, I just have to make sure I left it all on the court. And if that's the end, then I've had an amazing run."

Cregger is, of course, not finished making movies. His next film is the deep space sci-fi movie The Flood , starring Jennifer Lawrence. He said in the interview that it's his biggest-budget movie ever; previously, that record belonged to Resident Evil (a reported $75 million before marketing costs). Cregger said he shouldn't admit this publicly, but he believes there are real benefits to making movies on lower budgets, in part so a filmmaker like himself has to get creative as he works against constraints.

The Resident Evil movies are produced by Constantin Films, which bought the rights back in the '90s and has retained them ever since. After Welcome to Raccoon City flopped, Constantin planned to put the film franchise on ice ... until Cregger showed up with a pitch.
In addition to The Flood, Cregger is producing the next Weapons movie, which is the spin-off, Aunt Gladys.

items.title: 在《怪物火车 2》中玩了 500 小时后，最后的束缚天使派系正在教我新的获胜方法
items.summary: The Punished, coming soon to the outstanding deckbuilder, draw their power from self-flagellation.

content.v: Their aesthetic? Chains, whips; spiked. Their mood? Afflicted, condemned, ritualistic. Their angels? Dark. Their maiden? Iron.
Friendship ended with dwarven gearsmiths ; my new favorite clan in Monster Train 2 is the tortured edgelords.

The final faction being added to Monster Train 2, The Punished, arrive November 10 as a paid DLC. Their theme is self-damage, with new keywords and spells that, primarily, reward power in exchange for hurting yourself. Your pain? Enemies' bane.
Leaving a mark

Though existing MT2 clans like the Melting Remnant revolve around forms of sacrifice, The Punished are absolutely thirsty for it. They bring new keywords like Chained (enemy units take half the damage that your units take) that make damage an active solution to enemy waves. The self-flagellation angle likewise brings new purpose to some existing spells and equipment, and jives great with partner clans that provide protection from pain (Lazarus League) or more ways to inflict it (Pyreborne).

Damaging my own guys sounds like a risk-reward tactic that requires sophisticated play. In my first run as The Punished, I anticipated having to do brain-wracking calculus about how much damage to absorb. But instead, I've found the new clan to be one of the most powerful and, at least with one of their champions, easy to play.
A lot of that is down to the utility of their new gimmick, a big purple gem called the Monolith . Here's a breakdown of what makes it special:

"Level up the Monolith by sacrificing cards to earn Devotion, which grants Zeal, which buffs attack and HP for all units" kind of sounds like a line from a ProZD deckbuilder parody video (I will take any opportunity to reference the legendary Dairy Cow combo ), but it's really not complicated. Click the purple crystal, make cards go away, permascale a little bit.

Though it can change the calculus for a few units, Zeal isn't that game-breaking on its own: usually you're just increasing the ceiling of a unit's HP to set up cards like Zealot's Halo, an equipment that gives +1 attack for every 1 HP you're missing.

More potent is The Punished's starter champion, Archus, an S-tier champ that amps damage based on lost HP, but has the versatility to debuff enemy damage as well. All of his build paths grant him Flight. His best variant deploys a "Darkshard" into the lane he flies into, a 0-attack artifact that does one of the following, on your choice:

Bloodshed is really, really powerful with the right unit pairings and a cheap spell or two that hurts yourself. What's wild is that Archus can deploy a Darkshard in every lane, with a cooldown of 2 on his flight ability. I might anticipate a nerf on that. Scaling your whole floor from received hits (including self-targeted spells!) is a wonderful way to accelerate sweepers or backline bruisers. Archus good.
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/t5y8ETE9c5TTqbTefNcH4P-1920-80.jpg
Chain pain

Zariel, the other champ, is more advanced. The first angel cast out of heaven, "Zariel has been imprisoned for so long that her original crime has been forgotten to time." Sick. Although, you'd think that that would enable some kind of clemency?
Since her arms and wings are bound in chains, Zariel has no base attack. What she does have are three diverse paths that all play off sponging up as much damage as possible:

I asked Shiny Shoe CEO Mark Cooke what combos the studio has found useful with Zariel. "A lot of Hellhorned cards like Branding Rite, Dark Deal, and Inferno work really well with Zariel's Pain and Chain paths. Pox is a great spell for consistent friendly damage, because it applies Decay 10 to all units," says Cooke. "Zariel's Pain Maiden path especially synergizes well with The Condemned, because the unit has Tenacious, it won't die to any friendly damage and it even amplifies the damage it takes and redirects it to an enemy, so it's great for pinging and stacking Pain while still killing enemies."

On my second run with Zariel, in the final rounds of a battle, I was dealing 1000 damage from her Paintouch ability, and I was doing it each turn because the ability has a cooldown of 1. On a couple other attempts, I couldn't create damage outputting units to pair with her quickly enough, and my run collapsed.
The superstar of the roster might be Penitent Sentinel, an uncommon tank that becomes MT2's most durable frontliner.

This is one of the few weaknesses of The Punished—although several units have good base attack, instantaneous damage can be hard to acquire. Reaper of Suffering, The Punished's only sweeper, starts with a generous 60 attack (as much as Demon Fiend, a 4-cost Hellhorned unit), but it also starts Suppressed (meaning she cannot attack), needing a cooldown of 4 to expire before she emerges from that state. Taking damage decreases that cooldown, and incredibly, she heals to full HP when she emerges from Supressed and gains flight when you cross that threshold.

This isn't the only star unit on The Punished. Forsaken Berserker gains one multistrike for every two Monolith levels. Scarred Justicar, an uncommon, ended up being my damage solution on several runs. He simply gains +15 attack when hit by a friendly spell or ability, and considering one of the starter cards deals a gentle 2 damage, you can gain perhaps +30 or +45 attack in a round between spells and other effects. Slap a stack of multistrike and the new 3-cost equipment Sineater on him (Deal 8 damage to self, attack immediately, cooldown 2), and you have a high damage solution that just takes a little time to set up.

The superstar of the roster, though, might be Penitent Sentinel, an uncommon tank that becomes MT2's most durable frontliner if you're able to draft it early. This stoic statue unit cannot be healed, but it gains +1 HP on revenge, astoundingly rare health permascaling that is set-and-forget simple. I found myself taking the "enemies gain multistrike" trial just to welcome more attacks against Penitent Sentinel. In some runs I was ending with nearly 300 HP, linked to a Titanite upgrade that effectively doubled that. Wild.
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/z9XghogDYnY2L7rhUoeC2P-1920-80.jpg
Riding the pain train

After 12 wins with The Punished, I love that they have several viable units to pick from, and how much they synergize with a variety of clans. I kept finding new ways of winning with Zariel, and my strangest victory was with this configuration:
I had no plan and was mostly freestyling through this, my upgrade selections weren't particularly strong. I was surprised to beat Savagery, let alone the Titans.

After 500 hours in Monster Train 2, it's refreshing to beat the game in an unexpected way. I truly thought this run was doomed because I had little traditional damage, no sweep, no tank, and no decapitating spells.
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/WeUqSfjiNvjsdV3Tzocu6P-1920-80.jpg

The Punished's masochistic theme works. And Shiny Shoe's treatment of these tortured angels is nice (their Carolina Panthers-blue skin helps them stand out, even among the pale blue Melting Remnant), though their stoic reverence doesn't leave a lot of room for quirk.

I would've loved to have seen a silly torture sicko among the roster, but I'll settle for Lasher, the first backline unit that hits any friendly units positioned in front of him for 1 damage (I don't recommend relying on Damage Shield when he's on the floor). Just think of it as giving your guys a helpful, spiked-chain pat on the back.

items.title: RTX 5080 24GB或无法在2027年1月登场
items.summary: 最近一段时间显卡市场遭遇供应短缺，GeForce RTX 50系列面临较为严重的缺货，特别是高端的RTX 5090系列和RTX 5080，前者所使用的GB202芯片未来仅用于RTX Pro系列工作站显卡，后者英伟达打算以

content.v: 最近一段时间显卡市场遭遇供应短缺，GeForce RTX 50系列面临较为严重的缺货，特别是高端的RTX 5090系列和RTX 5080，前者所使用的GB202芯片未来仅用于RTX Pro系列工作站显卡，后者英伟达打算以RTX 5080 24GB代替，成为新的旗舰游戏显卡。传闻RTX 5080 24GB会在明年1月现身，定价也将高于目前的RTX 5080。
https://img.3dmgame.com/uploads/images/news/20261102/1793627201_108196.jpg
据Benchlife报道，虽然大家都知道RTX 5080 24GB将取代现售的RTX 5080，但是一直没有具体的时间表。最新消息称，英伟达至今还没有提供设计资料给合作伙伴，以正常流程，明年1月想看到新显卡的机率似乎并不高。
据了解，英伟达最初打算在10月给出相关的设计资料，甚至口头告知厂商会寄出，但是最终并没有这么做。考虑到目前厂商生产物料的准备情况，加上缺货等因素影响，在英伟达没有确定计划的前提下，想明年1月推出RTX 5080 24GB的难度很高。综合各方面的情况来看，新产品大概率仍会在2027年第一季度发布。
按照之前的消息，RTX 5080 24GB将改用24Gb（3GB）GDDR7模块，搭载GB203-450芯片，有着更高的核心频率，显存速率也从30Gbps提升至32Gbps，对应带宽从960GB/s提升至1024GB/s，TDP也从360W提高到415W。

content.v: 《复仇者联盟5》的预售票房一路飙升，这部即将上映的漫威电影即将突破一个重要的里程碑，其票房收入将超过DC宇宙超级大败作《超女》的全部票房收入。
据《福布斯》报道，《复仇者联盟5》自8月14日开售以来，仅预售票房就已超过1.25亿美元。令人难以置信的是，这使其票房即将超越今夏上映的《超女》的全球总票房（1.26亿美元）。考虑到1.25亿美元的预售数据公布至今已过去两天，《复联5》的票房很可能已经远远超过了《超女》。
https://img.3dmgame.com/uploads/images/news/20261102/1793626601_931132_jpg_r.jpg
截至9月，《复联5》的预售票房已超过5000万美元，而当时大多数地区的IMAX影院都只放映《沙丘3》。当然，如果你愿意，也可以在迪士尼认证的Infinity Vision银幕上观看这部电影。
在乔纳森·梅杰斯丑闻之后，漫威影业忙于调整《复联5》的计划，许多人对《复联5》的票房前景持怀疑态度。但现在，《复联5》必将大获成功已是不争的事实。至于它能否超越《蜘蛛侠4》的破纪录票房，则是另一个问题了。
漫威粉丝们通过《复仇者联盟4 ：终局之战》重映版额外体验了一把《复仇者联盟5》的精彩片段。此次重映包含四个全新场景，其中包括洛基出场的全新结局、两个片中彩蛋（其中一个揭示了杜姆绑架了布鲁斯·班纳），以及一个似乎将托尼·斯塔克和维克多·冯·杜姆联系起来的片尾彩蛋。
《复仇者联盟5》将于12月18日在美国上映，12月16日在英国和中国上映。

items.title: 由于“最重要”的 DirectX 更新，光线追踪内存使用量最多可减少 90%
items.summary: Potentially getting much more out of existing hardware is nothing to sniff at.

content.v: While I go 'oo' at every perfectly lit videogame vista, ray tracing can sometimes make my gaming rig go 'HNNNG'. I love a traced ray as much as the next person, but realistic reflections and lighting can be a bit of a memory hog. Thankfully, Microsoft is previewing something new for DirectX that could significantly take the load off many ageing rigs.

It's a pair of features called 'Clustered Geometry' and 'Partitioned TLAS'. At the risk of oversimplifying, you can think of this DirectX update as bringing tech very similar to Nvidia RTX Mega Geometry to every other GPU vendor.

Obviously there's more to it than that, though, with Microsoft describing this as the " most significant update [to DXR] since its debut in 2018 ." Top line: Microsoft's own testing of this update suggests it could reduce ray tracing memory load by as much as 90% without the need for a team green GPU (via Techspot ).

So, how does it work? Well, without this update, ray tracing is already beaming between less detailed versions of the geometry you see in-game. Traditional ray tracing tech does this because bouncing around detailed models afresh for every frame would simply take too long.

Clustered geometry slices up the detailed models into neat little packages of 256 triangles or fewer. Partitioned TLAS then does a similar thing for the entire videogame vista, splitting a scene into smaller regions. Why? Well, rather than searching the entire map every time, looking for what's changed and updating the frame accordingly, the ol' dread pirate Ray Tracing needs only to run their finger over the quadrants they know are different, marking the spot with 'X'—or something like that, the metaphor got away from me a bit in the middle there.
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/N36js7RR4FjLtQ6SMHBH5i-1920-80.jpg

Basically, this fresh DirectX tech massively simplifies the ray tracing data your rig has to check and update frame to frame. That could free up a whole lotta memory, with Microsoft demonstrating a reduction of 7.5 GB to 774 MB on an AMD Radeon RX 9070 . Obviously, frame rates also benefitted, jumping from a wince-worthy 1.2 fps to a very impressive 79 fps in Microsoft's testing.

Now, this isn't really a case of simply installing an update and, 'whee, you're flying!' Microsoft issues a fair few caveats—for one thing, not all games are going to replicate the wins its specialised test environment saw.

For another, working with clustered geometry and all of those packages of up to 256 triangles uses a lot more temporary scratch memory compared to traditional tech—that presents its own logistical concerns for game developers.

It's also worth reiterating that this update is not yet widely available, and there's no word yet on when PC gamers like you and me will be able to get our mitts on it either. If you feel like going sicko mode, though, Microsoft writes you can gain access to experimental features like this by using "matching Agility SDK preview headers and runtime, a supporting driver, and Windows Developer Mode."

Still, the potential to cut down memory usage without needing to buy any new hardware is very promising during these times of runaway pricing for both memory and GPUs . If I can put off a pricey upgrade for a few years more, I'll be happy.

items.title: Arc Raiders 开发者使用了有人在禁区发现的“切尔诺贝利钢琴”的音乐样本
items.summary: "A lot of the sounds in the game are quite unique."

content.v: Arc Raiders has a terrific soundscape, although it can sometimes be hard to hear it when you're getting hunted down by your fellow players or bloodthirsty arcs. The game is quite quiet, aside from the occasional sound of distant gunfire, the clicks and cracks from small roaming arcs, and the noise of shuffling scrap as raiders sort through abandoned buildings for valuable items. But perhaps the best noise in all of Arc Raiders comes from the few instruments raiders can find amid the rubble.

"One of the gameplay designers, really early on, made a trumpet," Pajor says. "And it was so out of place, and we were like 'why are we making it?'" The musical items in Arc Raiders serve multiple purposes. There's the social incentive to play an instrument, to bond with strangers and just show them that you're a harmless, relatively chill dude. But there's also the strategic purpose of using noises to lure arcs. Perhaps you're herding them into a trap or ambush or maybe you're trying to distract the aggro of one arc away from another vulnerable player.

Avid players of Arc Raiders will notice, however, that there's no trumpet available in game. Well that's because the trumpet eventually became what we now know as the lure grenade. Apparently a playable trumpet was just too silly to the devs at first, so they settled on something a bit more useful. But now, over a year later from launch players can enjoy multiple instruments like the piano, guitar, harmonica, flute, banjo, recorder, and the trusty shaker.

"It's been almost seven years of exploring this world. [Composers Patrik Andrén and Johan Söderqvist] used to be performing musicians before they became composers so they have a lot of friends who are Sweden's best jazz musicians," Pajor adds. "So a lot of the sounds in the game are quite unique because they are making the sound libraries.
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/sGejTNdyiUoyifskRyfkGU-1920-80.png

"It's their commitment to building a world; they're phenomenal world builders. So eager to understand what the game is and what the world is. They are also very demanding to work with, because they have so many ideas."

Aside from the Chernobyl piano, which is certainly one of the stranger sources of music I've heard of, composers Andrén and Söderqvist are also known for their abstract use of everyday items to make music and noises.

A lot of raw synthesisers are used to create arc-adjacent noises, but they've also hooked up different kinds of fruits to a synthesiser to grab some slightly weirder sounds. All in all, out of a three hour recording session there's usually only three minutes of usable sounds, "because it's sheer weirdness" but those three minutes "are really really really cool", Söderqvist adds, and stresses that you simply can't obtain these fantastically strange sounds another way.
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/TCou4LpWxSUzfBu3QPeR6P-1920-80.jpg

items.title: Valve 的 Steam Frame 跻身 Steam 最受欢迎 VR 头显前十名
items.summary: The Quest 3 still holds a significant lead, though.

content.v: Valve's second mighty expensive, yet mighty impressive VR headset, the Steam Frame , launched in the latter half of September, meaning October was the first full month where players could actually use it. The latest Steam Hardware Survey suggests a rather big bump in usage for Valve's VR headset this past month.

In September, the Steam Frame accounted for just 0.41% of VR headset usage. In October, that number jumped to 4.13%. That means it surpassed the Oculus Rift S, Sony PS VR2, HTC Vive, Windows Mixed Reality (which is a platform, as opposed to a single headset), the first Oculus Rift and Bigscreen Beyond. It is now the sixth most popular VR headset, sitting just .37% behind the Pico 4, and a hefty 24.14% behind the Meta Quest 3.
The 3.72% increase for the Steam Frame is the biggest jump upwards in October, and the biggest tumble was taken by the Oculus Quest 2, which lost 3.57%.

The Steam Frame officially released on September 18, with preorders going live on September 14, but that doesn't mean buyers got their hands on the headset on the day it went live. So the bump can not only be partially attributed to continued sales over October, but also to shipping times.

Given the Steam Frame has enjoyed such a large bump even with customers struggling to get their hands on the headset, this suggests the VR market on Steam isn't huge. Though it is worth taking these stats with a pinch of salt.

The Steam Hardware Survey is an opt-in survey Valve takes every month. This means it only looks at a fraction of Steam users to get general statistics. This is why stats tend to change a tad each month. For instance, the Nvidia GeForce RTX 3060 is currently the most popular graphics card in the survey, but it saw a 0.08% increase last month. The RTX 4060 saw a downward shift of 0.40%, pushing it below the RTX 3060.
As such, the Hardware Survey can only ever give a rough reading of usage each month, but it still seems like a good sign for Valve's latest bit of hardware.

items.title: 戴夫·巴蒂斯塔 (Dave Bautista) 增重 20 磅肌肉后，看起来更像奎托斯
items.summary: With filming set to resume soon on Prime Video's God of War series, 55-year-old actor Dave Bautista revealed i

content.v: With filming set to resume soon on Prime Video's God of War series, 55-year-old actor Dave Bautista revealed in an Instagram Story that he's packed on a beefy 20 pounds of muscle for the role of Kratos, bringing his weight to 250 pounds. While it's not the first time Bautista has bulked up for a role, he'd noticeably slimmed down in recent months, and he'd previously said he needed two months to get ready to play Kratos on TV.

While 250 pounds is an impressive weight, it's not the heaviest that Bautista has been during his career. At the peak of his WWE run, when he performed under the ring name Batista, the actor said he started at 325 pounds (as Deacon Batista) and once weighed 370 pounds. Over the years, Bautista usually hovered at around 290 pounds during his WWE runs, which is still massive . For 2023's Knock at the Cabin, Bautista increased his mass to 315 pounds to play the sinister character of Leonard, then began to slim down.

Bautista is stepping in to replace the original Kratos actor, Ryan Hurst, who also became absolutely shredded for the role. Sadly, a devastating bicep tear injury forced him to vacate the role, as he'd have needed months of downtime and rehabilitation to resume filming. Not wanting to wait that long, Amazon quickly began scouting for a replacement and chose Bautista for the series, of which two seasons have been ordered.

Based on the game series' soft reboot that began in 2018, God of War will follow Kratos and his son Atreus (Callum Vinson) as they journey across the nine realms. More games in the series are also on the way, starting with God of War Laufey on February 18, 2027, and a new Kratos-led adventure .

items.title: 钟薛高易主后正式开启预售！四支46元 便宜了一点
items.summary: 快科技11月2日消息，据媒体报道，今日，易主后的雪糕品牌“钟薛高”重新开售。

content.v: 快科技11月2日消息，据媒体报道，今日，易主后的雪糕品牌“钟薛高”重新开售。
京东平台“钟薛高京东自营旗舰店”显示，此次上线商品以四支装、八支装等组合装为主，包含轻牛乳、丝绒可可、半半巧巧等经典口味。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/11/02/small_202611022115457933.jpg
目前除京东外，其他电商平台暂未有钟薛高官方认证店铺销售。钟薛高表示，品牌正在与其他销售渠道接洽，相关店铺将陆续开设并恢复销售。
钟薛高京东自营旗舰店已开启预约，于11月3日0时开始抢购，售价为4支46-52.67元，折合11-13元/支，定价大幅下调。
据悉，今年5月，钟薛高食品（上海）有限公司名下商标、专利等508件无形资产按现状整体拍卖，吸引超过1.3万人围观。
9月，在钟薛高逐渐消失在公众视野之时，罗永浩的一条微博让品牌再度成为热点。
而在随后举行的第28届中国冰淇淋及冷冻食品产业博览会上，钟雪高品牌管理（上海）有限公司携“钟薛高”品牌重新亮相，并剧透产品将在2026年四季度回归上市。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/11/02/small_202611022115549199.png
此外，新东家当时还召开了媒体交流会，新CEO陈大成出席，原本是一位90后食品安全博主，拥有10年食品流通、生产从业经历。
陈大成表示自己是山东人，当地食品产业发达，便从事了食品行业，随后做了自媒体，成为钟薛高新CEO后，他说要注重好吃和安全，要组织研发团队把口味做好。
钟薛高成立于2018年，被称为雪糕界的爱马仕，最贵的雪糕单价66元，巅峰时销售额突破10亿元，估值超过40亿元。
然而2022年，钟薛高因“钟薛高火烧不化”“爱买不买”等引发巨大争议。
2023年，钟薛高接连被曝出欠薪、人员流失等问题；2024年，其创始人林盛更是因“直播卖红薯”还债，引发关注。

items.title: Xbox Game Pass 11 月份将失去 14 款游戏
items.summary: It's the start of a new month, which means new additions and departures on Xbox Game Pass. To kick off Novembe

content.v: It's the start of a new month, which means new additions and departures on Xbox Game Pass. To kick off November, 14 games are being removed from the Game Pass library soon, including several simulators, one longrunning Dragon Ball game, and one of the greatest James Bond adventures of all time--at least until that upstart 007 First Light popped up earlier this year.

Simulator fans can say goodbye to Football Manager 26, Firefighting Simulator, Pigeon Simulator, and Police Simulator this month. Believe it or not, those games all come from different developers, as it feels like there's a simulator for every category and hobby out there. Another noteworthy departure is Dragon Ball Xenoverse 2 , the action-RPG that was recently upgraded for current-gen consoles. The game has been around for several years and has grown with updates that add new characters and adventures, but with Dragon Ball Xenoverse 3 launching in the second half of 2027, it might be time to wave goodbye to the Time Patrol.

Also on the way are the first Moonlighter, the adorably cozy Winter Burrow, and Barbie Horse Trails. As a reminder, you can save 20% on these games if you decide to buy them before they leave Game Pass.
Leaving Xbox Game Pass on November 15
https://www.gamespot.com/wp-content/uploads/original/1601/16018044/4269819-xenoverse-12.jpg?w=636

This wave of games leaving Game Pass will be followed by a second batch of exits on November 30. Last month saw quite a few titles rotated out of Game Pass, including Expedition 33: Clair Obscur, The Casting of Frank Stone, A Plague Tale: Requiem, Donut County, and several Double Fine classics. At least some new games are filling that void, as Final Fantasy VII Remake Intergrade, Plants vs. Zombies: Replanted, and The Séance of Blake Manor were all added at the end of October.

items.title: 《龙帮》不会是 Nagoshi Studio 的第一款游戏。这根本不是任何游戏
items.summary: Nagoshi Studio, the studio formed by Yakuza creator Toshiro Nagoshi at NetEase, has been shut down before it e

content.v: Nagoshi Studio据称已经停止运营并进入法律清算程序，其首个游戏项目《龙帮》也被报道取消。相关消息称，股东大会于2026年10月31日作出清算决定，但目前尚无公司登记材料、网易公告或游戏取消声明予以确认。
https://img.3dmgame.com/uploads/images/news/20261102/1793600839_556318_jpg_r.jpg
这家日本工作室由《如龙》系列创作者名越稔洋于2022年成立。名越稔洋离开世嘉和如龙工作室后，在网易游戏支持下组建了这支新团队。
Nagoshi Studio在The Game Awards 2025公开了《龙帮》的电影式预告，并将其定位为新一代犯罪题材高预算动作游戏。2026年3月曾有消息称，该项目陷入开发困境，完成制作还需追加4440万美元；网易管理层认为继续投入并不合算，随后停止向团队提供资金。此后数月，多名关键设计师和高级开发人员陆续公开离职。
目前，《龙帮》的Steam页面据称仍标注“即将推出”。有关消息将工作室进入法律清算解读为项目已经取消，但这并非官方公布的取消结论；名越稔洋本人也尚未就未来计划发声。

items.title: 小米YU7一年期保值率82.3% 连续4个月纯电车型第一
items.summary: 今日小米汽车通过官方微博正式官宣，旗下车型YU7连续四个月蝉联同级别纯电车型保值率榜首，相关消息很快在汽车消费圈层引发大量讨论。

content.v: 今日小米汽车通过官方微博正式官宣，旗下车型YU7连续四个月蝉联同级别纯电车型保值率榜首，相关消息很快在汽车消费圈层引发大量讨论。
按照官方公布的信息，小米YU7的一年期保值率达到了82.3%，这一数据已经连续四个月稳居纯电动车型保值率榜单第一位，打破了此前外资品牌长期霸占纯电高保值率头名的行业固有印象。
https://img1.gamersky.com/image2026/11/20261102_zy_red_164_21/1410.jpg
这份权威保值率数据，来自中国汽车流通协会和精真估联合发布的《2026年10月中国汽车保值率研究报告》，在一年车龄保值率的细分榜单里，小米YU7以82.3%的成绩直接登顶，作为对照的特斯拉Model Y同期一年保值率仅为73.5%，二者差距十分明显。
紧随小米YU7之后的是理想i6和蔚来ES8，两款车型分列榜单第二、第三位，保值率分别为82.0%与77.5%，头部新能源车型之间的保值率竞争已经进入白热化阶段。
https://img1.gamersky.com/image2026/11/20261102_zy_red_164_21/1879.jpg
除此之外，MG4、乐道L90、理想i8、理想MEGA、极氪009、问界M8、小米SU7等多款市场热度很高的热门车型，也全部跻身榜单上游梯队，一年期保值率均突破了74.9%。
过去国内纯电车型保值率普遍偏低的刻板印象正在快速被打破，以小米为代表的国产品牌新能源车型，正在通过稳定的产品品质、完善的售后体系和逐年走高的市场认可度，一步步重塑整个新能源汽车行业的保值率评价体系，让国内消费者选购新能源车型时再也不用过多担心后续转手的大幅折损问题。

items.summary: 过去几周，由于AI模型的进步，针对当前主机系统的破解技术取得了显著进展。虽然主机破解通常是主机厂商力求尽快解决的重大问题，但索尼还有另一个原因：由于《GTA6》即将发售，索尼正与破解者展开一场“固件大战”。在PS5系统软

content.v: 过去几周，由于AI模型的进步，针对当前主机系统的破解技术取得了显著进展。虽然主机破解通常是主机厂商力求尽快解决的重大问题，但索尼还有另一个原因：由于《GTA6》即将发售，索尼正与破解者展开一场“固件大战”。
https://img.3dmgame.com/uploads/images/news/20261102/1793624579_973178_jpg_r.jpg
在PS5系统软件14.10.00版本更新一个月后， 14.22.00.00版本更新于今日发布。此次小版本更新引入了一些“系统软件安全修复”，毫无疑问，这是索尼与破解者之间固件大战的最新举措。
此次PS5系统更新之所以引人关注，是因为据报道它与11月19日发售的《GTA6》密切相关。据追踪PlayStation Network数据库更新的PlayStation Game Size网站报道，《GTA6》将需要14.22.00版本的固件，而非之前的14.10.00版本，这在以往是前所未有的。
然而，极端情况需要采取极端措施。鉴于《GTA6》预计将在PS5上销量最高，索尼绝不能容忍任何盗版漏洞。在AI时代，即使是最小的软件漏洞也可能造成严重后果。而且，盗版可能只是后果之一，因为游戏甚至可能在正式发售前就被模拟运行，并被重新编译成PC原生版本，这对索尼和Rockstar Games来说都将是灾难性的。
即使索尼接连发布多个PS5固件更新，破解和黑客们也不会善罢甘休，外媒预计这场冲突甚至会持续到11月19日《GTA6》发售之后。

items.title: Win10可直接升级到Win11 26H2 微软确认全量推送
items.summary: 微软确认Windows 11 26H2现已面向所有受支持设备全量推送，包括目前处于扩展支持阶段的Windows 10设备也可以直接升级到26H2。

content.v: 微软确认Windows 11 26H2现已面向所有受支持设备全量推送，包括目前处于扩展支持阶段的Windows 10设备也可以直接升级到26H2。
Windows 11 26H2于9月底正式发布，采用分阶段推送，逐步向符合条件的设备开放，以避免重大问题影响大量设备。
https://img1.gamersky.com/image2026/11/20261102_zy_red_164_19/1135.jpg
几天前微软确认25H2和24H2设备已全量推送，随后进一步扩大到所有符合条件的设备，包括Windows 10扩展支持用户。
微软官方状态页面写道：“截至2026年10月28日，Windows 11版本26H2现已面向所有符合条件的设备开放。此新版本包含Windows 11版本25H2和24H2中所有已公布的功能，将通过服务技术交付，提供快速安装体验。”
https://img1.gamersky.com/image2026/11/20261102_zy_red_164_19/1317.jpg
升级到26H2后，内存占用更低，PC响应更快，尤其是使用某些第三方精简工具剔除系统冗余组件后效果更明显。
如果已开启尽快获取最新更新开关但仍未收到26H2推送，最简单的方式是手动下载eKB5121794启用包。该包直接激活25H2和24H2系统中处于休眠状态的26H2功能，实现就地升级。
不过这种方式要求当前已在特定版本上，不适用于更旧的Windows 11版本或从Windows 10直接升级。
如果偏好全新安装，可以通过微软官方工具下载最新的KB5127648 ISO，Rufus等第三方工具也是不错的选择。

items.title: 理发店推298元剪发包年不限次活动 店家回应真实有效
items.summary: 近日，贵州遵义。有网友发帖晒出遵义一家理发店推出的年卡套餐，其中“298元一年剪发免费”的标语引发关注。

content.v: 据新浪新闻报道，近日，贵州遵义。有网友发帖晒出遵义一家理发店推出的年卡套餐，其中“298元一年剪发免费”的标语引发关注。
https://img1.gamersky.com/image2026/11/20261102_zy_red_164_18/162.jpg
11月2日，记者致电该理发店了解详情。接线店员证实该活动属实，298元剪发年卡男女通用，一年内不限次数，还表示“哪怕每天来都可以”，并且每次剪发都包含洗吹服务。对于如此低价如何盈利？工作人员坦言，“洗剪吹本身没什么利润”，此举相当于以极低价格回馈顾客，且该店已经营近十年，剪发年卡套餐并非开业限时活动。
查询发现，类似的低价包年理发服务并非个例。还有网友近日晒出一家男士理发店的招牌，上面写着“100块钱剪1年”。
https://img1.gamersky.com/image2026/11/20261102_zy_red_164_18/1275.jpg

items.title: 被取消的《传送门》前传F-Stop被社区复活 而且还能玩
items.summary: Valve于2007年开发、后来取消的《传送门》前传《F-Stop》，如今被社区利用多批泄露资料复原成近乎完整的可玩版本。体验者称，当前版本仍缺少少量素材和对白，但约有99%的内容可用。 Valve于2007年取消开发的

content.v: Valve于2007年开发、后来取消的《传送门》前传《F-Stop》，如今被社区利用多批泄露资料复原成近乎完整的可玩版本。体验者称，当前版本仍缺少少量素材和对白，但约有99%的内容可用。
https://img.3dmgame.com/uploads/images/news/20261102/1793623867_267945_jpg_r.jpg
Valve于2007年取消开发的《传送门》前传游戏《F-Stop》已经泄露到网上——目前完全可玩。如果你听说过《F-Stop》，就不用我多说了，你肯定知道这有多么重要。但如果你没听说过，那接下来我要好好给你上一堂历史课。
2007年，Valve花了三个月时间进行一个项目，Gabe Newell（G胖）后来将其命名为“定向设计实验”（Directed Design Experiments）。在这三个月里，Valve分成了五个小组。每个小组设计并部分制作了一个电子游戏“实验”，第五个小组被命名为“F-Stop ”。
《F-Stop》最初被构思为《传送门》的前传，其游戏玩法围绕着使用光圈科技的实验性相机来改变视角和解谜展开。Gabe Newell本人对这个项目非常着迷，但测试玩家却不太买账。最终《F-Stop》被取消，其部分对话、角色和机制被重新制作并应用到了《 传送门2 》中。
好吧，不必再把它当成废纸了，因为多亏了几位泄密者和Valve Cut Content团队的努力，《F-Stop》现在已经可以（几乎）完整地玩了。
如果你好奇这次泄露是怎么发生的，详细解释一下：这实际上是三次独立泄露事件的叠加。
有些人可能还记得，在八月下旬，大约13 TB的Steam仓库数据在网上泄露。这次泄露事件被称为Steam2，似乎包含了2003年至2013年间几乎所有的Steam仓库数据，最令人惊讶的是，其中还包括《F-Stop》的资源。
然而，尽管Steam2泄露的内容包含了F-Stop的大部分资源，但并未包含F-Stop的源代码或mapsrc数据（Valve用于存放地图源代码数据的文件夹名称）。看来， F-Stop的最后这两块拼图在过去48小时内通过Valve Cut Content项目的Discord服务器泄露了出来。
据服务器管理员称，泄露F-Stop地图源文件的人最初要价1000美元，但不知何故，最终还是免费赠送了这些文件。Valve的删减内容团队已经验证了地图文件的真实性，社区也已将这三个部分整合起来，最终呈现出一个完整的、可玩的F-Stop版本。
玩过的人反映，虽然游戏中似乎还缺少一些素材和对话，但整体完成度已经达到了99%。这并不奇怪，毕竟如果Valve真的打算正式发布这款游戏，肯定会进行更多润色。不过说实话，“99%完成度”可比上周这个时候的0%完成度强多了。
https://img.3dmgame.com/uploads/images/thumbnews/20260720/1784518943_551412.jpg

items.title: 谷歌有一个很酷的《塞尔达传说：时之笛》复活节彩蛋，让我们回到 1998 年搜索结果时代
items.summary: Google just got a The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time Easter egg that transports you back to the 1998 version

content.v: https://assets-prd.ignimgs.com/2026/11/02/zelda-1793622162850.png
Google just got a The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time Easter egg that transports you back to the 1998 version of the search engine — complete with blue links for results.

The remake of the Nintendo 64 classic comes out this Thursday, November 5, but you can find the secret on Google now if you type “zelda” into the search bar and press enter. This makes the Master Sword appear in the bottom-right corner of the screen.

Click the Master Sword and it gets shoved into its pedestal, an audio effect plays, and the screen distorts to pull you through time. Now you’re back at the old, useful, minimalist Google that showed search results as a series of blue links for people to click on.

What you’re seeing is Google from 1998, the year the original Ocarina of Time launched. It was the year of the Saving Private Ryan movie, the rise of teen pop icons like Britney Spears and breakthrough television shows like Sex and the City. The Boy Is Mine by Brandy and Monica would have been blasting from the stereos of passing cars, kids would have been playing with Furbys, and everyone was rocking a Nokia. Ah, nostalgia. Google’s 1998 version even has the “I’m feeling lucky” option, which would just take you to a random search result.

As Nintendo has pulled back the curtain on The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time remake , we’ve begun to get a better understanding of how this Nintendo Switch 2 exclusive will look and feel to play. IGN has already got you covered with an extensive hands-on preview , as well as a roundup of all the changes we’ve noticed so far compared to the N64 masterpiece.

While you wait, check out a special episode of Nintendo Voice Chat where we dive deeper into our Zelda preview. Meanwhile, Eiji Aonuma, producer of the Zelda series at Nintendo, recently admitted some of the younger members of his team had never played the original game , but insisted that was very much a good thing for the development of the remake.

items.title: 《影之刃零》多少人不知道这隐藏操作？一键收刀超帅
items.summary: 《影之刃零》发售后，不少玩家都在战斗结束后遇到同一个问题：主角拿着武器一路小跑，想收刀却找不到按键

content.v: 《影之刃零》发售后，不少玩家都在战斗结束后遇到同一个问题：主角拿着武器一路小跑，想收刀却找不到按键，只能靠交互或蹲下动作来间接完成收刀。对于一款以动作演出为卖点的游戏来说，这个细节多少有些别扭。
《影之刃零》 热销中 ！叠加金币至高省32元
有玩家近日在社区发帖指出，游戏其实存在专门的收刀操作，只是从未写进按键提示。具体方法是长按武器切换键，主角便会做出一个完整的收刀动作，干净利落。由于游戏的教学和按键说明里完全没有提到这一点，绝大多数玩家在通关过程中都没有发现，只能继续用交互或下蹲来“凑合”。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/11/02/small_202611022026046935.png
此前已有玩家讨论过部分影之武装的特殊用法、某些招式的隐藏派生，以及需要特定条件才能触发的处决动作。

items.title: 《战争机器：事变日》开发烧了5亿美元?这里面还包括虚幻5引擎定制费用
items.summary: 最近有报道称，《战争机器：事变日》多年来耗费了Xbox高达5亿美元的制作成本，如此高的预算使得这款游戏至少要卖出700万-900万份才能回本。现在Xbox前高级产品经理Derek Reese澄清说，这5亿美元的预算并非全

content.v: 最近有报道称，《战争机器：事变日》多年来耗费了Xbox高达5亿美元的制作成本，如此高的预算使得这款游戏至少要卖出700万-900万份才能回本。
https://img.3dmgame.com/uploads/images/news/20261102/1793623249_477822_jpg_r.jpg
现在Xbox前高级产品经理Derek Reese澄清说，这5亿美元的预算并非全部用于开发《战争机器：事变日》。
Derek Reese在社交媒体上解释说，《战争机器：事变日》开发商The Coalition在过去几年里面临着各种各样的运营成本。其中很大一部分来自于多年来微软定制的虚幻引擎以及《战争机器：事变日》开发工作。
https://img.3dmgame.com/uploads/images/news/20261102/1793623417_333626.jpg
Windows Central内部人士Jez Corden的一份报告也澄清说，Coalition曾与其他使用虚幻引擎的工作室合作，例如开发了《宣誓》、《地狱之刃2》、《腐烂国度3》以及即将推出的《星际争霸》重启版等游戏。多年来，其他诸多运营成本也使5亿美元的预算进一步增加。
《战争机器：事变日》目前在Steam和Xbox平台的总销量仅略超过40万份，据传Game Pass蚕食了其大部分销量。此外，该IP的销量也已不如鼎盛时期。
尽管The Coalition CEO暗示过，但我们仍然不知道该系列游戏未来 是否会推出新作。
虽然《战争机器：事变日》5亿美元被辟谣，但40万的销量正在被社交媒体上的玩家开刷，被最近发售的国产3A游戏《影之刃零》吊打：

items.title: 罗技广告再被指“侮辱用户像狗” 官方致歉了
items.summary: 11月2日，“罗技广告再被指侮辱用户”登上热搜，引发热议。

content.v: 据中国新闻网报道，11月2日，“罗技广告再被指侮辱用户”登上热搜，引发热议。
网友截图显示，“罗技G影音旗舰店官方号”在社交平台发布一条内容，配图为一张小狗表情包。视频中卡通狗表情包对“立减一百”表示“没兴趣”，却在“券后六折”时两眼放光直言“看人真准”，被网友普遍解读为再次暗讽消费者“像狗”。
https://img1.gamersky.com/image2026/11/20261102_zy_red_164_16/1154.jpg
涉事账号关联店铺客服2日对中新经纬表示，目前已展开调查，非常抱歉带来不好的体验，感谢公众的监督与理解。
针对此次宣传争议，罗技中国官方客服2日回应中新经纬称，非常抱歉旗下的授权店铺发布了引发争议的视频，会如实登记反馈，并进行调查。“如果后续核实，罗技会对该商家进行处罚，毕竟侮辱用户是非常严重的行为。”
https://img1.gamersky.com/image2026/11/20261102_zy_red_164_16/1311.jpg
这已是罗技今年第二次因类似内容翻车。今年3月，其授权店铺发布GPW3推广视频，配文“当我一降价，你还不是像狗一样跑过来”，引发全网声讨。随后代运营方被处以20万元行政罚款，罗技中国曾致歉称系员工跳过审核擅自发布。
https://img1.gamersky.com/image2026/11/20261102_zy_red_164_16/1424.jpg

items.title: 中国科研成果震撼老外：人类感谢中国人民

content.v: https://imggifb.gamersky.com/users/clubcontent/2026/11/02/origin_4630187_9243852.gif
让高位截瘫 8 年的患者，用意念就能上网、打游戏、操控智能家居的脑机接口。
动脉大出血，能在 30 秒内就快速止血的仿生人工血小板秒级止血技术。
可以无限续航，比 A4 纸还轻的微型飞行器。
在看到各个前沿科技领域的大佬们，齐刷刷出现在北京，在我面前深入浅出的讲解这些技术时，我知道，这次 Bilibili 超级科学晚，来对了。
https://img1b.gamersky.com/users/clubcontent/2026/11/02/origin_4630187_9243851.jpg
不过，怎么感觉海外博主，比差评君还兴奋。。。
https://img1b.gamersky.com/users/clubcontent/2026/11/02/origin_4630187_9243853.jpg
有网友表示，这是来自中国科技的亿点小震撼。
https://img1b.gamersky.com/users/clubcontent/2026/11/02/origin_4630187_9243856.jpg
也有网友发出了经典的感慨： 科技家 有国界，但科学不分国界。
https://img1b.gamersky.com/users/clubcontent/2026/11/02/origin_4630187_9243888.jpg
https://img1b.gamersky.com/users/clubcontent/2026/11/02/origin_4630187_9243855.jpg
看到这里，应该有人会好奇，这场晚会到底都说了些什么。
一直关注 Bilibili 超级科学晚的差友应该有发现，今年挺不一样。
白天有专家跟 UP 主的对谈跟专家 TED 演讲，晚上才是科技晚，活动从上午 11 点开始一直持续到晚上九点多，信息量爆炸。
所以看点也是非常多。。。
所以下面差评君挑几个我觉得最有趣的，给大家讲讲。
也是听上交大特聘教授的课了
https://img1b.gamersky.com/users/clubcontent/2026/11/02/origin_4630187_9243857.jpg
首先， 人造太阳，或者说可控核聚变。
https://img1b.gamersky.com/users/clubcontent/2026/11/02/origin_4630187_9243859.jpg
这四个字，超级常见，但组合一起，看着又无比陌生，晦涩，高难度。
好在中国科学院副研究员 王腾 挺懂科普，上来就用大白话抛出灵魂拷问：天上明明已经挂着一个太阳了，人类为啥还非得费劲巴拉地再手搓一个？
因为人造太阳能量密度极高， 开一千公里 车 （ 北京到上海 ），只需要一矿泉水瓶海水产生的聚变能量。
而且，不存在失控风险，能量管够，足够清洁，科学界觉得够吸引人。。。
紧接着，还解释了太阳如何实现聚变，地球上想实现聚变有啥挑战，装置长啥样等等。这里差评君就不复读了，感兴趣可以上 B 站搜搜~
https://img1b.gamersky.com/users/clubcontent/2026/11/02/origin_4630187_9243858.jpg
他们甚至把聚变实验装置 EAST 内部，真实的运行画面给放上来了。
别看它发出来的光是粉色系的，看着挺可爱，其实温度有上亿度。
https://imggifb.gamersky.com/users/clubcontent/2026/11/02/origin_4630187_9243869.gif
人造太阳什么时候能做好呢？是不是 “ 永远要等 50 年 ” ？
https://img1b.gamersky.com/users/clubcontent/2026/11/02/origin_4630187_9243864.jpg
这次大会上，他们也同步了个，可能让你出乎意料的结论：
“ 托卡马克的关键指标，每 1.8 年就会翻一番，这样的进步速度比计算机领域的摩尔定律（晶体管数量每 2 年翻一番）还快 ”。
所以，不用 50 年，我们这代人可能就能见证。。。
https://img1b.gamersky.com/users/clubcontent/2026/11/02/origin_4630187_9243860.jpg
如果说人工太阳让差评君联想到的是宏大，而接下来这个堪称 “ 微小 ” 。
因为 它是全球最小最轻的太阳能动力静电飞行器。
猜猜在哪？
对，就这么大。。。
这款飞行器，名为CoulombFly ，重量只有 4.21 克，这个重量包含了动力源、发动机跟螺旋桨等所有零部件，比一张 A4 纸还轻。凭借纯自然光就可以持续飞行。
很有趣，但是有什么用呢？
它厉害的地方，在于找到了一种高效率的微型驱动方式，像毛衣或者梳头的静电，这种微安级别的电流都可以让它动。
所以我们日常生活中很多无法被传统电机利用的能量，CoulombFly 的静电电机却可以拿来用，比如大气电场的能量，未来说不好可以永驻天空，基于这一点再搞点发明。
而它不发热的特性，未来也有可能应用到芯片散热，人形机器人之类的场景里。
其实形态也不是定死的，你可以再做大，也可以再做小嘛。。。
未来想象空间还是非常大滴~
所以在 2024 年发布的时候，也是 “ 轻轻松松 ” 成功登上了顶刊《 Nature 》。
除了这两个项目之外，还有脑机接口、人造血小板、机械鱼、原子核、黑洞、纺织新材料等等，咱不一一道来了，只能说这次 Bilibili 超级科学晚上，狠活是真多。。。
也难怪有网友调侃，这次属于是前沿科技神仙打架。
还有人说，该不会下一秒主持人就开始颁中国自己的诺贝尔奖了吧。。。
整场晚会看完，差评君也有两个感觉。
一来，其实就像前面那几位海外博主说的那样，中国的科学家总是特别接地气，每一个都奔着解决咱们生活中的实际问题去，即便是听起来超级高大上的人工太阳跟人工血小板，也是如此。
二来， 就是如今的年轻人对前沿科技是真热情啊。。。
活动现场乌泱泱都是年轻人，就连不少对谈，台上坐的专家、科技企业创始人看着也特年轻。
差评君还特地查了一下，根据 国家自然科学基金 委窦贤康今年公布的数据，2025 年度，80% 以上的科学基金项目由 45 岁以下的青年人承担。
年轻一代正在成为科研的中坚力量。。。
而且， 这群人不仅懂科学，也懂得怎么跟年轻人唠科学。
你一定听说过 “ 中二所 ” 的名头吧，中国科学院物理研究所在 B 站上开设的科普账号，@二次元的中科院物理所，就擅长用各种花活给你植入点硬核知识。

items.title: 和风民俗恐怖游戏《津岛·魂鬼》开放Steam页面并发布新预告
items.summary: 中国香港独立游戏团队Aurora Studio已开放第一人称和风民俗恐怖游戏《津岛·魂鬼》的Steam页面，同时发布最新预告片。游戏使用虚幻引擎5开发，正式版发售日期尚未公布。本作从日本江户时代的东海道、神道信仰及妖怪传

content.v: 中国香港独立游戏团队Aurora Studio已开放第一人称和风民俗恐怖游戏《津岛·魂鬼》的Steam页面，同时发布最新预告片。游戏使用虚幻引擎5开发，正式版发售日期尚未公布。
本作从日本江户时代的东海道、神道信仰及妖怪传说中获取创作灵感。玩家将跟随从古老封印中苏醒的巫女津岛真羽，探索被遗忘的村落、墓地和神社，在人界与灵界交错的环境里调查封印仪式失败的真相。
https://img.3dmgame.com/uploads/images/news/20261102/1793621391_522663.jpg
游戏并不侧重激烈战斗，而是围绕灵异调查、环境探索和仪式体验展开。玩家可借助“灵视”发现隐藏的灵异痕迹，使用御守收集徘徊人间的魂魄，再寻找神社祭坛完成净化。团队表示，后续内容还会逐步扩展江户宿场町调查、妖怪遭遇和牛车巡礼等部分。
https://img.3dmgame.com/uploads/images/news/20261102/1793621401_241598_jpg_r.jpg
https://img.3dmgame.com/uploads/images/news/20261102/1793621403_765532_jpg_r.jpg
Aurora Studio此前参与过《巴士模拟2：Project Numazu》的开发及跨国发行，并将《津岛·魂鬼》视为继续发展原创知识产权的重要项目。目前游戏仍在开发，Windows早期试玩版已通过itch.io开放，团队正在持续改进核心玩法与场景。
https://img.3dmgame.com/uploads/images/news/20261102/1793621899_105223_jpg_r.jpg

items.title: 今年最"叫好不叫座"的独游神作！值得你沉下心体验

content.v: https://img1b.gamersky.com/users/clubcontent/2026/11/02/origin_2649595_9243550.jpg
https://img1b.gamersky.com/users/clubcontent/2026/11/02/origin_2649595_9243552.jpg
一场持续十年的、奢侈的设计实验，理应交给时间来评价。
《沉星之序》已经发售三周了。作为今年声名最盛的独立游戏之一，它的Steam好评率达到了惊人的96%，在评论区，你也能看到许多近乎狂热的赞美：
“看别人玩没意思，看主播reaction没意思，看攻略也没意思，但是亲自玩的人乐在其中，这是真正好玩的游戏。”
还有玩家称它是“登峰造极的解谜游戏，会是解谜游戏史上一部极为重要的作品”。
https://img1b.gamersky.com/users/clubcontent/2026/11/02/origin_2649595_9243551.jpg
https://img1b.gamersky.com/users/clubcontent/2026/11/02/origin_2649595_9243553.jpg
我能理解这种心情，我一度十分沉迷，日思夜想那些推箱子的关卡。加上地图十分简洁，所有的谜题，甚至可以完整带入睡梦中思考。
https://img1b.gamersky.com/users/clubcontent/2026/11/02/origin_2649595_9243554.jpg
同样沉迷的朋友，意犹未尽地找来了更多推箱子游戏来玩。
https://img1b.gamersky.com/users/clubcontent/2026/11/02/origin_2649595_9243591.jpg
但时至今日，我也没有完全通关《沉星之序》，甚至感觉，通关就像个遥不可及的理想，被人问起只能长叹一声说“徐徐图之”。
毕竟，这是一款号称拥有1000多个手工打造关卡的解谜游戏。在采访中，吹哥曾提到，仅仅通往游戏第一个结局的内容，就已经接近一款大型游戏的体量。
偏偏它又选在10月9日上线。对国内玩家来说，国庆假期刚刚结束，大家正式复工复学。你很难想象一个人在这个时候，还能精神满满地开启这样一款游戏——
https://img1b.gamersky.com/users/clubcontent/2026/11/02/origin_2649595_9243557.jpg
很难不望而生畏的大地图
所以，即便它目前仍维持着惊人的好评率，整体的评价数却无法与这样的口碑相匹配，多少显得有些“叫好不叫座”。
https://img1b.gamersky.com/users/clubcontent/2026/11/02/origin_2649595_9243555.jpg
我想，评测数少的原因，是还有大量的玩家尚未对更多人分享他们游玩的感受。即使是已经投入几十个小时的玩家，也可能只体验了其中的一部分内容，遑论看见游戏的全貌。
和朋友谈论它的时候，我时常会有一种盲人摸象的感觉。我想写点什么，却又觉得对它的认识始终是零碎的。玩过的部分十分令人着迷，没玩过的部分又实在太多，以至于很难把它们拼成一幅完整的图景。
要理解《沉星之序》为什么这样难以把握，或许可以先从一面镜子说起。
在游戏正式发售前，不少人可能已经通过Demo接触过它的几种核心机制。它们分布在东南西北四个区域，各自拥有一套规则。
单独来看，这些机制并不难理解，但随着游戏推进，这些看似简单的机制会不断衍生出新的用途，并且开始相互组合，逐渐产生出更复杂、有趣的联系。
（下文涉及剧透，包含部分谜题内容，若介意请下滑至3部分）
以东方的镜之群岛为例，这里的核心机制是玩家可以通过镜子传送自身。
镜子会向两个互相垂直的方向射出光束，当玩家站上其中一条光束，游戏会在另一条光束上离镜子同样远的位置显示你的虚影。使用镜子，两者的位置就会互换。
https://imggifb.gamersky.com/users/clubcontent/2026/11/02/origin_2649595_9243560.gif
但接下来，有一道关卡出现了两个终点，玩家却只能操控一个商人。
怎么办？答案竟然是把自己变成两个人。
只要让商人站在两面相对的镜子之间，再使用镜子，原本应该交换位置的商人就会一分为二。
https://img1b.gamersky.com/users/clubcontent/2026/11/02/origin_2649595_9243558.jpg
更妙的是，这个发现还可以继续推广。
既然可以一分为二，那是不是也可以合二为一？
我还在畅想，结果游戏马上就给我“两个商人+一个终点”的情况。这种“我想到，我实现”的感觉实在太爽了。
https://img1b.gamersky.com/users/clubcontent/2026/11/02/origin_2649595_9243559.jpg
既然人能够这样分裂，那么其他东西呢？是的，可以。
在不远处的一关，我在被近乎绝望、不可触达终点的地图折磨的时候，突然灵光一闪，想到了利用镜子无限复制水晶（一种可以被镜子反射的石头），然后用水晶给自己铺路。
一格一格走过去的时候，我明显感觉自己突破了某种思维的藩篱。
https://img1b.gamersky.com/users/clubcontent/2026/11/02/origin_2649595_9243561.jpg
但我很快发现，自己还是低估了这面镜子。
在更靠后的关卡里，玩家需要操纵两个独立的商人。此前，我一直在考虑怎样调整自己的站位，利用镜子传送到想去的地方。但当一个商人被传送到远处，另一个商人却可以留在原地推动镜子，改变下一次传送的位置。
此前，玩家考虑的是如何利用镜子移动自己，在这些关卡中，玩家还需要考虑如何借助另一人来移动镜子——镜子从一个静止的物件变成了一个可动的变量。只是多了一个人，原本无法跨越的距离又有了解法。
以上这些机制并没有直接的指引，除了初遇需要主动按键交互的新机制时，游戏会给出操作提示 （比如告诉你按X传送） ，绝大多数情况下，玩家只得自行在关卡中完成学习和验证。
但做到这一点却并不困难，因为在这些关卡里，镜子的玩法机制被准确地拆分和凸显，你能清晰地察觉开发者的目的，并由此推测出某种终局状态，倒推完成解谜。

这让我想起吹哥在2015年接受《Vanity Fair》采访时曾说 “游戏设计师应该相信，玩家本来就是聪明的，并给他们机会锻炼这种能力，让自己变得更聪明。” （Game designers should believe that people are intrinsically smart and give them a chance to exercise those muscles and become better at it.）
在完成几个地区分散的谜题之后，游戏很快会迎来黄金谜题，这里会将不同方位的主题两两结合，组合出新的谜题。
北方的主题是“搬运英雄”，这里的角色拥有各异的能力，而这些能力，既是他们的优势，也会成为他们在推箱子时的限制。在“英雄与魔镜”的系列关卡中，你会感受到吹哥是如何提取不同玩法机制的特征，并精妙地加以组合的。
比如仅仅围绕“镜子可以腾挪人和物品”的能力，游戏就设计出了这样的拆分关卡：
吟游诗人的能力是用歌声控制身旁5x5的区域，这其中的水晶、哥布林和人物会跟着她移动。借助镜子的反射，玩家可以改变吟游诗人与水晶的相对位置，让原本相互牵制的对象分离。
盗贼的能力是拉取——她本身不能推箱子，但当她站在物品或人的旁边，往反方向走，就能带着其移动。镜子的传送能力则让她能够在移动物体之后脱身，不必一直黏在一起。
此前提到的、借助两面镜子实现的“一分为二、合二为一”，也再次派上了用场：
德鲁伊能够将植物变成水晶，再将其还原。而在镜子的帮助下，原本占据不同位置的水晶还可以合二为一，为他腾出通路。
到了南方的飞石与魔镜组合关卡，我又见到了一个意想不到的设计。
一块正在空中飞行的水晶，竟然也能被镜子反射。它不会因为传送而停下来，而是保留原来的运动，随着镜子的朝向改变飞行方向。
原本向上飞的石头，就这样突然向左飞去。
图源水印 B站@塞德莎
我想，这些关卡让人印象深刻的地方，在于镜子的规则始终没有改变，但它与不同对象之间的关系被反复挖掘之后，能产生符合直觉，但又耳目一新的效果。
在游戏发行商Gamirror Games组织的《沉星之序》玩家见面会的分享中，吹哥曾用一张矩阵来描述这种关系。他让我们把游戏中的对象和机制想象成一个个点，而它们之间可能发生的交互，则是连接这些点的线。如果把所有对象分别排列在矩阵的横轴和纵轴上，每一个格子，就代表着两种对象之间潜在的交互。

items.title: 十年磨一剑的世界级IP大作 被自己的“主人”背叛而死

content.v: https://imggifb.gamersky.com/users/clubcontent/2026/11/02/origin_4009731_9243714.gif
文丨TY
排版丨鹿九
成也萧何，败也萧何
10月27日，拳头花费近十年心血打造的《2XKO》，迎来了最后一次更新。这次更新带来了两位新角色，瑟提和莎弥拉，然后便宣布一切光荣结束。虽然早在八月份，拳头就宣布要“做一个艰难的决定”，但如今它真来临了，也难免有些唏嘘。
https://img1b.gamersky.com/users/clubcontent/2026/11/02/origin_4009731_9243707.jpg
给不了解《2XKO》的朋友先简单介绍一下，这是拳头开发的一款以《英雄联盟》这个ip为基础的格斗游戏。
https://img1b.gamersky.com/users/clubcontent/2026/11/02/origin_4009731_9243710.jpg
最早公布这款游戏的消息是在2019年的EVO，当时还称之为《Project L》，首次亮相就让许多格斗游戏玩家感到非常兴奋。首先就是《英雄联盟》这种大ip的传统格斗游戏，对于许多玩家来说是非常值得期待的。毕竟大ip的号召力能吸引更多人入坑，构建出良性的社区生态。
并且背后的团队也请来了格斗游戏领域的大神 Cannon 兄弟，如果不了解他们的话，你只需要知道，EVO是他们创办的，他们还开发了GGPO，为回滚联网技术在格斗游戏中的推广作出了重要贡献。
https://img1b.gamersky.com/users/clubcontent/2026/11/02/origin_4009731_9243709.jpg
而且那几年的拳头，也是如日中天，双城之战热播，无畏契约全球爆火，各种IP衍生单机层出不穷，也立项MMO，吊足了玩家的胃口，所有的事情都在欣欣向荣，俨然一副要取代暴雪的感觉。
但就是在万众瞩目之下，《2XKO》选择了缄默。直到2025年8月，才正式发布，但等了这么久之后，迎接《2XKO》的并不是玩家泼天的欢呼，而是一片死寂。
2026年1月正式上线，没过多久就被爆出拳头大幅裁掉了《2XKO》项目组的员工，8月就发布了停更公告，如今进行了最后一次大更新，草草收场，留下一地鸡毛。
https://img1b.gamersky.com/users/clubcontent/2026/11/02/origin_4009731_9243706.jpg
十年磨一剑，这下针磨成针了，而这让人不由得想问，《2XKO》为什么会走向失败？
2XKO
首先，时至今日，我个人觉得《2XKO》依然算不上一款“烂”游戏，相反，我认为《2XKO》是好玩的，甚至是有潜力给格斗游戏带来一些新鲜血液的。
但对现阶段想要破圈的传统格斗游戏来说，有几个点是离不开的。
首先就需要从各种方面去降低玩家的上手门槛，得吸引更多的新玩家。目前主流的做法，就是在操作上，给玩家减负。《碧蓝幻想VS》的简易出招获得玩家的肯定后，《街霸6》更是推出了划时代的现代模式，除了能简易出招的同时，甚至有自动连击。这些系统极大地降低了玩家的上手门槛。
https://img1b.gamersky.com/users/clubcontent/2026/11/02/origin_4009731_9243708.jpg
另一方面，需要做出差异化，因为虽然格斗游戏是一个小众门类，但是却有非常多的子类型，并且如果作为一款格斗游戏的下位替代，那几乎永无翻身之日。所以我们能看到，现阶段的格斗游戏要么是一个门类里面的goat，要么IP有着极大的号召力吸引玩家。
https://img1b.gamersky.com/users/clubcontent/2026/11/02/origin_4009731_9243711.jpg
而提到吸引玩家，就不得不说格斗游戏最关键也最重要的一点，极度依赖活跃的社区去推动游戏的热度，而社区也能培养一批非常忠实的玩家。因为本质上，格斗游戏是一个非常依赖玩家胜负欲的游戏种类。玩格斗游戏的驱动力只有一个，变强，然后战胜他人，而足够活跃的社区，才能让玩家有人想要战胜，也有足够多水平相近的玩家可以切磋。
《2XKO》面对这些重点，也都采取了相应的措施。在简易出招上，《2XKO》直接取消了传统的指令出招，改为组合按键出招，一来降低了玩家的门槛，二来减少了玩家所需要练习出招的时间成本，甚至一定程度上拉平了格斗老炮和新玩家的水平线，毕竟老玩家搓了10多年的623在《2XKO》里都没用了。
在差异化上，在横版单人格斗被《街霸6》《罪恶装备：奋战》垄断，3D格斗被《铁拳》死死守住阵地的情况下，《2XKO》选择了援护系统作为独特之处。以援护系统作为差异化也很好理解，首先，《2XKO》早期的1v1测试并不理想，所以需要增加一些额外的变量，其次，在当时市面上的援护格斗游戏也的确缺少一款新作。
https://img1b.gamersky.com/users/clubcontent/2026/11/02/origin_4009731_9243716.jpg
而最后，社区推广，《2XKO》选择了拳头一直以来的Free to Play，同时承诺不做Pay to Win的付费模式。而在社区上，《2XKO》天然拥有着社区号召力，首先开发团队是Cannon兄弟，背后有着EVO给他们推波助澜。
所以从纸面数据上来看，《2XKO》似乎是一款很难“输”的游戏，许多格斗游戏能做到这三点的其中一点，至少就能收获一批忠实的玩家，更不用说《2XKO》背靠世界级的大IP，背靠拳头这种实力雄厚的大公司，光是这些资源，就已经让许多格斗游戏望尘莫及，就飞龙骑脸怎么输？
但在《2XKO》看似豪华的资源配置背后，却是针针见血，刀刀致命。
问题所在
《2XKO》虽然取消了指令出招，但这并不代表《2XKO》就是一款低门槛，好上手的格斗游戏，甚至可以说，《2XKO》是非常难上手、非常复杂的格斗游戏。
https://img1b.gamersky.com/users/clubcontent/2026/11/02/origin_4009731_9243712.jpg
首先是《2XKO》有着极其夸张的连招系统，除了数量非常多，连招十分复杂以外，有些连招需要用到非常多格斗游戏的高阶技巧，目押、刷键等等。而且判定也十分严苛，甚至在EVO赛场上，都能看见选手频繁掉招。
我们的绿冲哥Punk在尝试女警连招时，也被整崩溃了，不仅要记住复杂的连招，还要精准地按出来，最后甚至还需要瞄准。
https://img1b.gamersky.com/users/clubcontent/2026/11/02/origin_4009731_9243713.jpg
这时，你还要想到，《2XKO》并不是一款单人对战的格斗游戏哦，它是一款有着援护系统的格斗游戏，也就是说作为一个正常玩家来说，你要熟悉两位角色，这拉高了玩家的入门门槛不说，其实还变相地增加了玩家的练习成本。
https://img1b.gamersky.com/users/clubcontent/2026/11/02/origin_4009731_9243717.jpg
并且有切人和援护的加入，连招的复杂程度会更上一层。只是官方提供的连招练习就已经够玩家喝一壶了，更不用说社区开发出来的极限连招，想要能在实战中稳定地打出来，又不知得付出多少日夜的练习。
而在最后，也是最严重的问题，开发和运营。拳头发布公告，停止更新《2XKO》是因为游戏没能达到预期的游玩人数，加上他们为此花费了太多时间，所以才做出了这样一个艰难的决定。
事实的确如此，拳头为《2XKO》的布局，早在2016年就开始了。Cannon兄弟在2011年成立了Radiant Entertainment，当时就在开发以简易出招为玩法核心的格斗游戏《Rising Thunder》，获得不少玩家的喜爱。
https://img1b.gamersky.com/users/clubcontent/2026/11/02/origin_4009731_9243715.jpg
还获得了2015年TGA最佳格斗游戏提名
2016年拳头收购了Radiant Entertainment，于是Cannon兄弟带着自己的班子开发《2XKO》，而这一开发，就是10年。而之前我们也提到过，《2XKO》曾经因为1V1的测试效果并不理想，所以重做过战斗系统。
并且，拳头一直以来的开发思路都有一些复古美式，就像卡马克那样必须把引擎做出来一样，拳头需要攻克某一个技术难关，比如在《无畏契约》中，他们就要攻克服务器刷新率从64tick到128tick。《2XKO》也不例外，Cannon 兄弟也要为《2XKO》革新回滚代码，于是就这样，《2XKO》的开发进度一直不太理想。
而到了24年8月，《2XKO》才有了第一次外部测试。2025年8月，才以公开测试的形式正式发布，但这么多年的开发，端上来的内容量太少了，首发角色都只有8名，这还是一款玩家需要选两名角色对战的援护格斗游戏。
除了开发时间长之外，还有一个影响《2XKO》成绩的就是运营。
首先这个不明所以的名字《2XKO》，就十分招笑，虽然能反推出表达了2人格斗和KO，但是太过于抽象，以至于我给朋友推荐，都要说：“《2XKO》，就是《英雄联盟》的那款格斗游戏”。
另一个很严重的问题是没有第一时间登录主机平台，对于海外市场来说，格斗游戏在主机上非常重要，尤其是社区格斗文化，十分依赖游戏机。
对于我来说，没有开拓中国市场也是《2XKO》的败笔，毕竟中国是世界上《英雄联盟》玩家人数最多的国家，对《2XKO》感兴趣的玩家自然不在少数。
总之，这些问题组合到一起，也许就使得游戏的游玩人数，比拳头预计的低了很多。于是，看着不理想的成绩，拳头从裁员开始，一步一步地停止了《2XKO》开发。对于玩家来说，《2XKO》是一款无人在意，死在路边的游戏吗？
你如果这样认为，就错了。事实上，《2XKO》的社区不仅没有死寂，反倒是至今依旧十分活跃。而停止《2XKO》并不是因为没人玩，而是拳头的决定。
事实上，真要说《2XKO》最致命的问题，其实正是拳头自己。
Riot
格斗游戏是更依赖社区、依赖线下的，以《2XKO》目前社区的活跃程度来看，至少命不该绝于此。首先《2XKO》的新角色PV在油管上随时都100万的播放量，Reddit社区的周活跃也有2k，算是非常不错的活跃度了。
甚至《2XKO》的EVO参赛人数也是只排在《街霸6》和《铁拳8》后面，并且和《铁拳8》的参赛人数相仿，共有1080名玩家报名，已经算是非常热门的项目了。
但拳头8月份发布那则公告中，声称《2XKO》是不及预期所以才选择停更了，这个消息对于国内的我们来说，从表面的确如此，毕竟《2XKO》没有真正意义上进入国内，DAU达不到预期也是可以预想的。

items.summary: 精工已在美国开售绿色表盘的Prospex Alpinist GMT腕表HBC007，定价1150美元。消费者可通过精工美国网上商店及授权经销商购买，该型号并非限量款，已被纳入Prospex常规产品目录。HBC007是日本

content.v: 精工已在美国开售绿色表盘的Prospex Alpinist GMT腕表HBC007，定价1150美元。消费者可通过精工美国网上商店及授权经销商购买，该型号并非限量款，已被纳入Prospex常规产品目录。
https://img.3dmgame.com/uploads/images/news/20261102/1793582690_448030_jpg_r.jpg
HBC007是日本市场SBEJ005的国际版本。SBEJ005于2023年10月7日发售，最初仅在日本Seiko Global Brand Core Shops销售。英国零售商此前以1100英镑开放订购，澳大利亚精品店标价1800澳元，目前美国授权零售渠道也已陆续到货。
腕表采用39.5毫米不锈钢表壳，表耳间距46.4毫米，厚度13.6毫米，表面带有精工超硬涂层，防水深度为200米。弧形蓝宝石水晶镜面内侧设有防反射涂层，透底设计可以展示机芯。棕色皮革表带适配20毫米表耳，并配备不锈钢折叠扣。
森林绿色太阳纹表盘搭配金色教堂式指针和立体时标，3、6、9、12点位置采用阿拉伯数字，4点半方向设有不带放大镜的日期窗。指针与时标覆有LumiBrite夜光材料，金色GMT指针使用红色箭头尖端，可配合固定钢制表圈上的24小时刻度读取时间；4点位表冠则用于转动绿色内置指南针环。
HBC007搭载Caliber 6R54自动机芯，支持手动上链与停秒，振频为每小时21600次，配备24颗宝石，动力储存约三天。其标称日误差为正25秒至负15秒，24小时指针可以独立调校。HBC007由此成为国际版Alpinist GMT常规阵容中的第三种标准表盘配色。

As brought to our attention by Serebii 's Joe Merrick , the company has been sharing images on social media of its 30th anniversary icons , with a number underneath.
